ghanathavahinchina theyophilaa,
aarambhamunundi kannu laara chuchi vaakyasevakulainavaaru manaku appaginchina prakaaramu manamadhyanu neraverina kaaryamulanugoorchi vivaramuga vraayutaku anekulu poonukonnaaru
ganuka neeku upadheshimpabadina sangathulu nishchayamugaa jariginavani neevu telisikonutaku vaatinannitini modatanundi tharachi parishkaaramugaa telisikoniyunna nenunu nee perata
vaatinigoorchi varusagaa rachinchuta yukthamani yenchithini.
yoodayadheshapu raajaina herodu dinamulalo abeeyaa tharagathilonunna jekaryaa anu oka yaajakudundenu. Athani bhaarya aharonu kumaarthelalo okate; aame peru eleesabethu.
veeriddaru prabhuvuyokka sakala maina aagnalachoppunanu nyaayavidhula choppunanu nirapa raadhulugaa naduchukonuchu dhevuni drushtiki neethimanthulai yundiri.
eleesabethu godraalainanduna vaariki pillalu lekapoyiri; mariyu vaariddaru bahu kaalamu gadachina (vruddhulairi.)
jekaryaa thana tharagathi kramamuchoppuna dhevuniyeduta yaajaka dharmamu jariginchuchundagaa
yaajaka maryaada choppuna prabhuvu aalayamuloniki velli dhoopamuveyutaku athaniki vanthu vacchenu.
dhoopa samayamandu prajala samoohamanthayu velupala praarthana cheyuchundagaa
prabhuvu dootha dhoopavedika kudivaipuna nilichi athaniki kanabadagaa
jekaryaa athani chuchi, tondharapadi bhayapadina vaadaayenu.
appudaa dootha athanithoojekaryaa bhaya padakumu; nee praarthana vinabadinadhi, nee bhaaryayaina eleesabethu neeku kumaaruni kanunu, athaniki yohaanu anu peru pettuduvu.
athadu prabhuvu drushtiki goppavaadai, draakshaarasamainanu madyamainanu traagaka,
thana thalligarbhamuna puttinadhi modalukoni parishuddhaatmathoo nindukonina vaadai,
ishraayeleeyulalo anekulanu prabhuvaina vaari dhevuni vaipunaku trippunu.

mariyu athadu thandrula hrudayamulanu pillala thattunakunu, avidheyulanu neethi manthula gnaanamu nanusarinchutakunu trippi, prabhuvu koraku aayatthapadiyunna prajalanu siddha parachutakai eleeyaayokka aatmayu shakthiyu galavaadai aayanaku mundhugaa vellunu ganuka neeku santhooshamunu mahaa aanandamunu kalugunu; athadu puttinanduna anekulu santhooshinthuranenu.
jekaryaayidi naakelaagu teliyunu? Nenu musalivaadanu, naabhaaryayu bahukaalamu gadachinadani aa doothathoo cheppagaa
doothanenu dhevuni samukhamandu niluchu gabriyelunu; neethoo maatalaaduta kunu ee suvarthamaanamu neeku teluputakunu pampabadithini.
mariyu naa maatalu vaatikaalamandu neraverunu; neevu vaatini nammaledu ganuka ee sangathulu jarugu dinamu varaku neevu maatalaadaka maunivai yunduvani athanithoo cheppenu.
prajalu jekaryaakoraku kanipettuchundi, aalayamunandu athadu aalasyamu chesinanduku aashcharyapadiri.
athadu velupaliki vachinappudu vaarithoo maatalaadaleka poyinanduna, aalayamu nandu athaniki darshanamu kaliginadani vaaru grahinchiri; appudathadu vaariki sangnalu cheyuchu, moogavaadai yundenu
athadu sevacheyu dinamulu sampoorna mainappudu thana yintiki vellenu.
aa dinamulaina pimmata athani bhaarya eleesabethu garbhavathiyai manushyulalo naakundina avamaanamunu theesi veyutaku
nannu kataakshinchina dinamulalo prabhuvu eelaaguna chesenanukoni, ayidu nelalu itharula kanta badakundenu.
aarava nelalo gabriyelanu dhevadootha galilayaloni najarethanu oorilo
daaveedu vanshasthudaina yosepanu oka purushuniki pradhaanamu cheyabadina kanyakayoddhaku dhevuni chetha pampabadenu. aa kanyaka peru mariya.
aa dootha lopaliki vachi aamenu chuchidayaapraapthuraalaa neeku shubhamu; prabhuvu neeku thoodaiyunnaadani cheppenu.
aame aa maataku bahugaa tondharapadi'ee shubhavachana memito ani aalochinchu konuchundagaa
dootha mariyaa,bhayapadakumu; dhevunivalana neevu krupapondithivi.
idigo neevu garbhamu dharinchi kumaaruni kani aayanaku yesu anu peru pettuduvu;
aayana goppavaadai sarvonnathuni kumaarudanabadunu; prabhuvaina dhevudu aayana thandriyaina daaveedu sinhaasanamunu aayana kichunu.
aayana yaakobu vanshasthulanu yugayugamulu elunu; aayana raajyamu anthamulenidai yundunani aamethoo cheppenu.
anduku mariya nenu purushuni eruganidaanane; yidhelaagu jarugunani doothathoo anagaa
doothaparishuddhaatma neemeediki vachunu; sarvonnathuni shakthi ninnu kammukonunu ganuka puttabovu shishuvu parishuddhudai dhevuni kumaarudanabadunu.
mariyu nee bandhuvuraalu eleesabethukooda thana vruddhaapyamandu oka kumaaruni garbhamu dharinchi yunnadhi; godraalanabadina aameku idi aaravamaasamu;
dhevudu cheppina yemaatayainanu nirarthakamu kaaneradani aamethoo cheppenu.
anduku mariya idigo prabhuvu daasuraalanu; nee maata choppuna naaku jarugunu gaaka anenu. Anthata dootha aameyoddha nundi vellenu.
aa dinamulayandu mariya lechi yoodhaa pradhesha mu loni konda seemalonunna oka ooriki tvaragaa velli
jekaryaa yintilo praveshinchi, eleesabethuku vandhanamu chesenu.
eleesabethu mariyayokka vandhanavachanamu vina gaane, aame garbhamulo shishuvu ganthulu vesenu. Anthata eleesabethu parishuddhaatmathoo nindukoninadai biggaragaa itlanenu
streelalo neevu aasheervadhimpabadinadaanavu nee garbhaphalamunu aasheervadhimpabadunu
naa prabhuvu thalli naa yoddhaku vachuta naa kelaagu praapthinchenu?
idigo nee shubhavachanamu naa chevinipadagaane naa garbhamuloni shishuvu aanandamuthoo ganthulu vesenu.
prabhuvu aameku teliyajeyinchina maatalu siddhinchunu ganuka nammina aame dhanyuraalanenu.
appudu mariya yitlanenu naa praanamu prabhuvunu ghanaparachuchunnadhi.
aayana thana daasuraali deenasthithini kataakshinchenu
naa aatma naa rakshakudaina dhevuniyandu aanandinchenu.
sarvashakthimanthudu naaku goppakaaryamulu chesenu ganuka idi modalukoni annitharamulavaarunu nannu dhanyuraalani yanduru. aayana naamamu parishuddhamu.
aayanaku bhayapaduvaarimeeda aayana kanikaramu thara tharamulakundunu.
aayana thana baahuvuthoo paraakramamu choopenu vaari hrudayamula aalochana vishayamai garvishthulanu chedharagottenu.
sinhaasanamulanundi balavanthulanu padadrosi deenula nekkinchenu
aakaligoninavaarini manchi padaarthamulathoo santrupthi parachi dhanavanthulanu vattichethulathoo pampivesenu.
abraahaamunakunu athani santhaanamunakunu yugaanthamuvaraku thana kanikaramu choopi gnaapakamu chesikondunani manapitharulathoo selavichinattu
aayana thana sevakudaina ishraayelunaku sahaayamu chesenu.
anthata mariya, yinchuminchu moodu nelalu aamethookooda undi, pimmata thana yintiki thirigi vellenu.
prasavakaalamu vachinappudu eleesabethu kumaaruni kanenu.
appudu prabhuvu aamemeeda mahaakanikaramunchenani aame poruguvaarunu bandhuvulunu vini aamethoo kooda santhooshinchiri.
enimidava dinamuna vaaru aa shishuvuku sunnathi cheyavachi, thandri perunubatti jekaryaa anu peru vaaniki pettabovuchundagaa
thalli aalaagu vaddu; vaaniki yohaananu peru pettavalenani cheppenu.
anduku vaaru nee bandhuvulalo aa peru galavaadevadunu lede ani aamethoo cheppi
vaaniki e peru pettagoru chunnaavani vaani thandriki sangnaluchesi adigiri.
athadu vraathapalaka temmani vaani peru yohaanani vraasenu; anduku vaarandaru aashcharyapadiri.
ventane athani noru teravabadi, naaluka sadali, athadu dhevuni sthuthinchuchu maatalaadasaagenu.
andunubatti vaari chuttupatla kaapuramunna vaarikandarikini bhayamu kaligenu. aa sangathulanniyu yoodaya kondaseemalayandanthata prachura maayenu.
prabhuvu hasthamu athaniki thoodaiyundenu ganuka aa sangathulanu goorchi vininavaarandarunu ee bidda yelaativaadaguno ani vaatini manassulo unchukoniri.
mariyu athani thandri jekaryaa parishuddhaatma poornudai yitlu pravachinchenu
prabhuvaina ishraayelu dhevudu sthuthimpabadunugaaka
aayana thana prajalaku darshanamichi, vaariki vimochana kalugajesenu
thana sevakudaina daaveedu vanshamunandu manakoraku rakshanashrungamunu, anagaa
mana shatruvulanundiyu manalanu dveshinchu vaarandari chethinundiyu thappinchi rakshana kalugajesenu.
deeninigoorchi aayana aadhinundi thana parishuddhapravakthala nota palikinchenu.
aayana mana pitharulanu karuninchutakunu thana parishuddha nibandhananu, anagaa mana thandriyaina
abraahaamuthoo thaanu chesina pramaanamunu gnaapakamu chesikonutakunu
manamu shatruvula chethinundi vidipimpabadi, mana jeevitha kaalamanthayu nirbhayulamai, aayana sannidhini
parishuddhamugaanu neethigaanu aayananu sevimpanu anugrahinchutakunu ee rakshana kalugajesenu.
mariyu o shishuvaa, neevu sarvonnathuni pravakthavana baduduvu mana dhevuni mahaa vaatsalyamunubatti vaari paapamu lanu kshaminchutavalana
thana prajalaku rakshanagnaanamu aayana anugrahinchu natlu aayana maargamulanu siddhaparachutakai neevu prabhuvunaku mundhugaa naduthuvu.

mana paadamulanu samaadhaana maargamuloniki nadipinchunatlu chikatilonu maranacchaayalonu koorchunduvaariki velugichutakai aa mahaa vaatsalyamunubatti painundi aayana manaku arunodaya darshanamanugrahinchenu.
shishuvu edigi, aatmayandu balamu pondi, ishraayelu naku pratyakshamagu dinamuvaraku aranya mulo nundenu.
aa dinamulalo sarvalokamunaku prajaasankhya vraayavalenani kaisaru augusthuvalana aagna aayenu.
idi kureniyu siriyadheshamunaku adhipathiyai yunna ppudu jarigina modati prajaasankhya.
andarunu aa sankhyalo vraayabadutaku thamathama pattanamulaku velliri.
yosepu daaveedu vanshamulonu gotramulonu puttinavaadu ganuka, thanaku bhaaryagaa pradhaanamu cheyabadi garbhavathiyai yundina mariyathookooda aa sankhyalo vraaya badutaku
galilayaloni najarethunundi yoodayaloni betlehemanabadina daaveedu ooriki vellenu.
vaarakkada unnappudu aame prasavadhinamulu nindenu ganuka
thana tolichoolu kumaaruni kani, potthiguddalathoo chutti, satramulo vaariki sthalamu lenanduna aayananu pashuvula tottilo parundabettenu.
aa dheshamulo kondaru gorrela kaaparulu polamulo undi raatrivela thama mandanu kaachukonu chundagaa
prabhuvu dootha vaariyoddhaku vachi nilichenu; prabhuvu mahima vaarichuttu prakaashinchinanduna, vaaru mikkili bhayapadiri.
ayithe aa doothabhaya padakudi; idigo prajalandarikini kalugabovu mahaa santhooshakaramaina suvarthamaanamu nenu meeku teliyajeyu chunnaanu;
daaveedu pattanamandu nedu rakshakudu mee koraku putti yunnaadu, eeyana prabhuvaina kreesthu
daanikidhe meekaanavaalu; oka shishuvu potthiguddalathoo chutta badi yoka tottilo pandukoniyunduta meeru chuchedharani vaarithoo cheppenu.
ventane paraloka sainyasamoohamu aa doothathoo koodanundi
sarvonnathamaina sthalamulalo dhevuniki mahimayu aayana kishtulaina manushyulaku bhoomimeeda samaadhaanamunu kalugunugaaka ani dhevuni sthootramu cheyuchundenu.

aa doothalu thamayoddhanundi paralokamunaku vellina tharuvaatha aa gorrela kaaparulujarigina yee kaaryamunu prabhuvu manaku teliyajeyinchi yunnaadu; manamu betlehemuvaraku velli choothamu randani yokanithoonokadu cheppukoni
tvaragaa velli, mariyanu yosepunu tottilo pandukoniyunna shishuvunu chuchiri.
vaaru chuchi, yee shishuvunugoorchi thamathoo cheppabadina maatalu prachuramu chesiri.
gorrela kaaparulu thamathoo cheppina sangathulanugoorchi vinna vaarandaru mikkili aashcharyapadiri.
ayithe mariya aa maatalanniyu thana hrudayamulo thalaposikonuchu bhadramu chesikonenu.
anthata aa gorrela kaaparulu thamathoo cheppabadinattugaa thaamu vinnavaatini kannavaatinannitinigoorchi dhevuni mahima parachuchu sthootramucheyuchu thirigi velliri.
aa shishuvunaku sunnathi cheyavalasina yenimidava dinamu vachinappudu, garbhamandaayana padakamunupu dhevadoothachetha pettabadina yesu anu peru vaaru aayanaku pettiri.
moshe dharmashaastramuchoppuna vaaru thammunu shuddhi chesikonu dinamulu gadachinappudu
prathi tolichoolu magapilla prabhuvuku prathishtha cheyabadavalenu ani prabhuvu dharmashaastramandu vraayabadinattu aaya nanu prabhuvuku prathishthinchutakunu,
prabhuvu dharmashaastra mandu cheppabadinattu guvvala jathanainanu rendu paavurapu pillalanainanu baligaa samarpinchutakunu, vaaru aayananu yerooshalemunaku theesikonipoyiri.
yerooshalemu nandu sumeyonanu oka manushyudundenu. Athadu neethi manthudunu bhakthiparudunaiyundi, ishraayeluyokka aadharanakoraku kanipettuvaadu; parishuddhaatma athanimeeda undenu.
athadu prabhuvuyokka kreesthunu choodaka munupu maranamu pondadani athaniki parishuddhaatmachetha bayalu parachabadi yundenu; aatmavashudai athadu dhevaalayamu loniki vacchenu.
anthata dharmashaastrapaddhathi choppuna aayana vishayamai jariginchutaku thali dandrulu shishuvaina yesunu dhevaalayamuloniki theesikonivachinappudu
athadu thana chethulalo aayananu etthikoni dhevuni sthuthinchuchu itlanenu
naathaa, yippudu nee maatachoppuna samaadhaanamuthoo nee daasuni ponichuchunnaavu;
anyajanulaku ninnu bayaluparachutaku velugugaanu nee prajalaina ishraayeluku mahimagaanu
neevu sakala prajalayeduta siddhaparachina
nee rakshana nenukannulaara chuchithini.
yosepunu aayana thalliyu aayananugoorchi cheppa badina maatalanu vini aashcharyapadiri.
sumeyonu vaarini deevinchi idigo aneka hrudayaalochanalu bayalu padunatlu, ishraayelulo anekulu padutakunu thirigi lechutakunu vivaadaaspadamaina guruthugaa eeyana niyamimpabadiyunnaadu;
mariyu nee hrudayamuloniki oka khadgamu doosikonipovunani aayana thalliyaina mariyathoo cheppenu.
mariyu aasheru gotrikuraalunu panooyelu kumaartheyunaina anna anu oka pravaktri yundenu. aame kanyaatvamu modalu edendlu penimitithoo sansaaramuchesi bahukaalamu gadichinadai,
yenubadhi naalugu samvatsaramulu vidhavaraalaiyundi, dhevaalayamu viduvaka upavaasa praarthanalathoo reyimbagallu sevacheyuchundenu.
aamekooda aa gadiyalone lopaliki vachi dhevuni koniyaadi, yerooshalemulo vimochanakoraku kanipettuchunnavaarandarithoo aayananu goorchi maatalaaduchundenu.
anthata vaaru prabhuvu dharmashaastramu choppuna samasthamu theerchina pimmata galilaya loni najarethanu thama ooriki thirigi velliri.
baaludu gnaanamuthoo nindukonuchu, edigi balamu ponduchundenu; dhevuni daya aayanameeda nundenu.
paskaapandugappudu aayana thalidandrulu eteta yerooshalemunaku velluchunduvaaru.
aayana pandreṁ dendlavaadai yunnappudu aa panduga naacharinchutakai vaadukachoppuna vaaru yerooshalemunaku velliri.
aa dinamulu theerina tharuvaatha vaaru thirigi velluchundagaa baaludaina yesu yerooshalemulo nilichenu.
aayana thalidandrulu aa sangathi erugaka aayana samoohamulo unnaadani thalanchi, yoka dinaprayaanamu saagipoyi, thama bandhuvulalonu nelavainavaarilonu aayananu vedakuchundiri.
aayana kanabadananduna aayananu vedakuchu yerooshalemunaku thirigi vachiri.
moodu dinamulaina tharuvaatha aayana dhevaalayamulo bodhakula madhya koorchundi, vaari maatalanu aalakinchuchu vaarini prashnaladuguchu undagaa chuchiri.
aayana maatalu vininavaarandaru aayana pragnakunu pratyuttharamulakunu vismaya mondiri.

aayana thalidandrulu aayananu chuchi mikkili aashcharyapadiri. aayana thallikumaarudaa, mammunu endukeelaagu chesithivi? Idigo nee thandriyu nenunu duḥkhapaduchu ninnu vedakuchuntimani ayanathoo cheppagaa
aayanameerela nannu vedakuchuntiri? Nenu naa thandri panulameeda nundavalenani meererugaraa ani vaarithoo cheppenu;
ayithe aayana thamathoo cheppina maata vaaru grahimpaledu.
anthata aayana vaarithoo kooda bayaludheri najarethunaku vachi vaariki lobadi yundenu. aayana thalli ee sangathulannitini thana hrudayamulo bhadramu chesikonenu.
yesu gnaanamandunu, vayassunandunu, dhevuni dayayandunu, manushyula daya yandunu vardhillu chundenu.

thiberikaisaru elubadilo padunaidava samvatsaramandu yoodayaku ponthipilaathu adhipathigaanu, galilayaku herodu chathurthaadhipathigaanu, ithooraya trakoneethi dheshamulaku athani thammudaina philippu chathurthaadhipathigaanu, abi lene dheshamunaku lusaaniya adhipathigaanu,
annayu, kayapayu pradhaana yaajakulugaanu, unnakaalamuna aranyamulonunna jekaryaa kumaarudaina yohaanu noddhaku dhevuni vaakyamu vacchenu.
anthata athadu vachi, paapakshamaapana nimitthamu maaru manassu vishayamaina baapthismamu pondava lenani yordaanu nadee pradheshamandanthata prakatinchu chundenu.
prabhuvu maargamu siddhaparachudi aayana trovalu saraalamucheyudi
prathi pallamu poodchabadunu prathi kondayu mettayu pallamu cheyabadunu vankara maargamulu thinnanivagunu karaku maargamulu nunnanivagunu
sakala shareerulu dhevuni rakshana choothuru ani aranyamulo kekaluveyuchunna yokani shabdamu ani pravakthayaina yeshayaa vaakyamula granthamandu vraayabadinattu idi jarigenu.
athadu thanachetha baapthismamu pondavachina janasamoohamulanu chuchi sarpasanthaanamaa, raabovu ugrathanu thappinchukonutaku meeku buddhi cheppina vaadevadu?

maarumanassunaku thagina phalamulu phalinchudi abraahaamu maaku thandri ani meelo meeranukona modalupettukonavaddu; dhevudu ee raallavalana abraahaamunaku pillalanu puttimpagaladani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
ippude goddali chetla veruna unchabadi yunnadhi ganuka manchi phalamu phalinchani prathi chettunu narakabadi agnilo veyabadunani cheppenu.
anduku janulu aalaagaithe mememi cheyavalenani athani nadugagaa
athadurendu angeelugalavaadu emiyu lenivaanikiyya valenaniyu, aahaaramugalavaadunu aalaage cheyavale naniyu vaarithoo cheppenu.
sunkarulunu baapthismamu pondavachi bodhakudaa, mememi cheyavalenani athani nadugagaa
athadu meeku nirnayimpabadinadaani kante ekkuva theesikonavaddani vaarithoo cheppenu.
sainikulunu mememi cheyavalenani athani nadigiri. Anduku athadu'evanini baadhapettakayu, evani meedanu apaninda veyakayu, mee jeethamulathoo trupthipondiyundudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
prajalu kanipettuchu, ithadu kreesthayi yundunemo ani andarunu yohaanunu goorchi thama hrudayamulalo aalochinchukonuchundagaa

yohaanu nenu neellalo meeku baapthismamichuchunnaanu; ayithe naakante shakthi manthudokadu vachuchunnaadu; aayana cheppula vaarunu vipputaku nenu paatrudanu kaanu; aayana parishuddhaatma lonu agnithoonu meeku baapthismamichunu;
aayana cheta aayana chethilonunnadhi; aayana thana kallamunu baagugaa shubhramuchesi, thana kottulo godhumaluposi, aarani agnithoo pottu kaalchi veyunani andarithoo cheppenu.
idiyugaaka athadinkanu, chaala sangathulu cheppi prajalanu heccharinchuchu vaariki suvaartha prakatinchu chundenu.
ayithe chathurthaadhipathiyaina heroduchesina sakala dushkaaryamula nimitthamunu, athani sodaruni bhaaryayaina herodiya nimitthamunu, yohaanu athanini gaddinchinanduku
adhivaraku thaanu chesinavanniyu chaala vannattu athadu yohaanunu cherasaalalo veyinchenu.
prajalandarunu baapthismamu pondinappudu yesukooda baapthismamu pondi praarthana cheyuchundagaa aakaashamu teravabadi
parishuddhaatma shareeraakaaramuthoo paavuramuvale aayanameediki digi vacchenu. Appudu neevu naa priya kumaarudavu, neeyandu nenaanandinchuchunnaanani yoka shabdamu aakaashamunundi vacchenu.
yesu (bodhimpa) modalupettinappudu aayana daadaapu muppadhi endla yeedugalavaadu; aayana yosepu kumaarudani yenchabadenu. Yosepu heleeki,
helee matthathuku, matthathu leviki, levi melkeeki,
melkee yannaku, yanna yosepuku, yosepu matthatheeyaku, matthatheeya aamosuku, aamosu naahomuku, naahomu esliki, esli naggayiki,
naggayi mayathuku, mayathu matthatheeyaku, matthatheeya simiyaku, simiya yoshekhuku, yoshekhu yodaaku,
yodaa yohannaku, yohanna resaaku, resaa jerubbaabeluku, jerubbaabelu shayalthee yeluku, shayaltheeyelu neriki,
neri melkeeki, melkee addiki, addi kosaamuku, kosaamu elmadaamuku, elmadaamu eruku,
eru yehoshuvaku, yehoshuva eleeyejeruku, eleeyejeru yoreemuku, yoreemu matthathuku, matthathu leviki,
levi shimyonuku, shimyonu yoodhaaku, yoodhaa yosepuku, yosepu yonaamuku, yonaamu elyaa keemuku,
elyaakeemu meleyaaku, meleyaa mennaaku, mennaa matthathaaku, matthathaa naathaanuku, naathaanu daaveeduku,
daaveedu yeshshayiki, yeshshayi obeduku, obedu boyajuku, boyaju shalmaanuku, shalmaanu nayassonuku,
nayassonu ammeenaadaabuku, ammeenaadaabu araamuku, araamu esromuku, esromu peresuku, peresu yoodhaaku,
yoodhaa yaakobuku, yaakobu issaakuku, issaaku abraahaamuku, abraahaamu tera huku, terahu naahoruku,
naahoru serooguku, seroogu rayooku, rayoo peleguku, pelegu heberuku, heberu shelahuku,
shelahu keyinaanuku, keyinaanu arpakshaduku, arpakshadu shemuku, shemu novahuku, novahu lemekuku,
lemeku methooshelaku, methooshela hanokuku, hanoku yereduku, yeredu mahala leluku, mahalalelu keyinaanuku,
keyinaanu enoshuku, enoshu shethuku, shethu aadaamuku, aadaamu dhevuniki kumaarudu.
yesu parishuddhaatma poornudai yordaanu nadhi nundi thirigi vachi, naluvadhi dinamulu aatmachetha aranyamulo nadipimpa badi
apavaadhichetha shodhimpabaduchundenu. aa dinamulalo aayana emiyu thinaledu. Avi theerina tharuvaatha aayana aakaligonagaa
apavaadhi neevu dhevuni kumaarudavaithe, rotte agunatlu ee raathithoo cheppumani aayanathoo cheppenu
anduku yesu manushyudu rottevalana maatrame jeevinchadu ani vraayabadiyunnadani vaaniki pratyuttharamicchenu.
appudu apavaadhi aayananu theesikonipoyi, bhooloka raajyamulannitini oka nimishamulo aayanaku choopinchi
ee adhikaaramanthayu, ee raajyamula mahimayu neekitthunu; adhi naakappagimpabadiyunnadhi, adevaniki nenu iyyagoruduno vaanikitthunu;
kaabatti neevu naaku mrokkithivaa yidanthayu needagunani aayanathoo cheppenu.
anduku yesu nee dhevudaina prabhuvunaku mrokki aayananu maatramu sevimpavalenu ani vraayabadiyunnadani vaaniki pratyutthara micchenu.
pimmata aayananu yerooshalemunaku theesikonipoyi, dhevaalaya shikharamuna aayananu niluvabettineevu dhevuni kumaarudavaithe ikkadanundi krindiki dumukumu
ninnu kaapaadutaku ninnu goorchi thana doothalaku aagnaapinchunu.
nee paadameppudainanu raathiki thagulakunda vaaru ninnu chethulathoo etthikonduru ani vraayabadiyunnadani aayanathoo cheppenu.
anduku yesu nee dhevudaina prabhuvunu shodhimpavaladu ani cheppabadiyunnadani vaaniki pratyuttharamicchenu.
apavaadhi prathi shodhananu muginchi, konthakaalamu aayananu vidichipoyenu.
appudu yesu, aatma balamuthoo galilayaku thirigi vellenu; aayananugoorchina samaachaaramu aa pradheshamandanthata vyaapinchenu.
aayana andarichetha ghanathanondi, vaari samaajamandiramulalo bodhinchuchu vacchenu.
tharuvaatha aayana thaanu perigina najarethunaku vacchenu. thana vaaduka choppuna vishraanthidinamandu samaajamandiramu loniki velli, chaduvutakai niluchundagaa
pravakthayaina yeshayaa granthamu aayana chethi kiyyabadenu; aayana granthamu vippagaa -

prabhuvu aatma naameeda unnadhi beedalaku suvaartha prakatinchutakai aayana nannu abhishekinchenu cheralonunna vaariki vidudalanu, gruddivaariki choopunu, (kalugunani) prakatinchutakunu naliginavaarini vidipinchutakunu
prabhuvu hithavatsaramu prakatinchutakunu aayana nannu pampiyunnaadu. Ani vraayabadina chootu aayanaku dorakenu.
aayana granthamu chutti parichaarakunikichi koorchundenu.
samaaja mandiramulo nunnavaarandaru aayananu therichoodagaa, aayananedu mee vinikidilo ee lekhanamu neraverinadani vaarithoo cheppasaagenu.
appudandarunu aayananugoorchi saakshyamichuchu, aayana notanundi vachina dayagala maatala kaashcharyapadi eeyana yosepu kumaarudu kaadaa? Ani cheppukonuchundagaa

aayana vaarini chuchivaidyudaa, ninnu neeve svasthaparachukonumu anu saametha cheppi, kapernahoomulo e kaaryamulu neevu chesithivani memu vintimo, aa kaaryamulu ee nee svadheshamandunu cheyumani meeru naathoo nishchayamugaa cheppuduranenu.
mariyu aayana'e pravakthayu svadhesha mandu hithudukaadani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
eleeyaa dinamulayandu moodendla aaru nelalu aakaashamu mooyabadi dheshamandanthatanu goppa karavu sambhavinchinappudu, ishraayelulo anekamandi vidhavaraandrundinanu,
eleeyaa seedonuloni saarepathu anu oorilo unna yoka vidhavaraaliyoddhake gaani mari evari yoddhakunu pampabadaledu.

mariyu pravakthayaina eleeshaa kaalamandu ishraayelulo aneka kushtharogulundinanu, siriya dheshasthudaina nayamaanu thappa mari evadunu shuddhi nondaledani nenu meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
samaajamandiramulo unnavaarandaru aa maatalu vini
aagrahamuthoo nindukoni, lechi aayananu pattanamulo nundi vellagotti, aayananu thalakrindugaa padadroyavalenani thama pattanamu kattabadina kondapetuvaraku aayananu theesikoni poyiri.
ayithe aayana vaari madhyanundi daati thana maargamuna vellipoyenu.
appudaayana galilayaloni kapernahoomu pattanamu naku vachi, vishraanthidinamuna vaariki bodhinchu chundenu.
aayana vaakyamu adhikaaramuthoo koodinadai yundenu ganuka vaaraayana bodhaku aashcharyapadiri.
aa samaaja mandiramulo apavitramaina dayyapu aatmapattina vaadoka dundenu.
vaadunajareyudavaina yesoo, maathoo neekemi? Mammu nashimpajeya vachithivaa? nee vevadavo nenerugudunu; neevu dhevuni parishuddhudavani biggaragaa kekalu vesenu.
anduku yesu oorakundumu, ithanini vadali pommani daanini gaddimpagaa, dayyamu vaanini vaarimadhyanu padadrosi vaaniki e haaniyu cheyaka vadali poyenu.
andu kandaru vismayamondi idi etti maata? eeyana adhikaaramuthoonu balamuthoonu apavitraatmalaku aagnaa pimpagaane avi vadalipovuchunnavani yokanithoo nokadu cheppukoniri.
anthata aayananugoorchina samaachaaramu aa praanthamulandanthatanu vyaapinchenu.
aayana samaajamandiramulonundi lechi, seemonu intiloniki vellenu. Seemonu attha theevramaina jvaramuthoo padiyundenu ganuka aame vishayamai aayanayoddha manavi chesikoniri.
aayana aame chenthanu niluvabadi, jvaramunu gaddimpagaane adhi aamenu vidichenu; ventane aame lechi vaariki upachaaramu cheyasaagenu.

sooryudasthaminchuchundagaa naanaavidha rogamulachetha peedimpabaduchunnavaaru evarevariyoddhanundiro vaarandaru aa rogulanu aayanayoddhaku theesikoni vachiri; appudaayana vaarilo prathivaanimeeda chethulunchi, vaarini svasthaparachenu.
inthekaaka dayyamuluneevu dhevuni kumaarudavani kekalu vesi anekulanu vadalipoyenu; aayana kreesthu ani vaatiki telisiyundenu ganuka aayana vaatini gaddinchi vaatini maataadaneeyaledu.
udayamainappudu aayana bayaludheri aranya pradhesha munaku vellenu. Janasamoohamu aayananu vedakuchu aayanayoddhaku vachi, thammunu vidichi pokunda aapagaa
aayananenithara pattanamulalonu dhevuni raajyasuvaarthanu prakatimpavalenu; indunimitthame nenu pampabadithinani vaarithoo cheppenu.
tharuvaatha aayana yoodaya samaajamandiramulalo prakatinchuchundenu.
janasamoohamu dhevuni vaakyamu vinuchu aayanameeda paduchundagaa aayana gennesarethu sarassutheeramuna nilichi,
aa sarassu theeramunanunna rendudonelanu chuchenu; jaalarulu vaatilonundi digi thama valalu kaduguchundiri.
aayana aa donelalo seemonudaina yoka done yekkidarinundi konchemu troyumani athani nadigi, koorchundi donelonundi janasamoohamulaku bodhinchuchundenu.
aayana bodhinchuta chaalinchina tharuvaatha neevu donenu lothunaku nadipinchi, chepalu pattutaku mee valalu veyudani seemonuthoo cheppagaa
seemonu elinavaadaa, raatri anthayu memu prayaasapadithivi gaani maakemiyu dorakaledu; ayinanu nee maata choppuna valalu vethunani aayanathoo cheppenu.
vaaraalaagu chesi visthaaramaina chepalu pattiri, anduchetha vaari valalu pigilipovuchundagaa
vaaru veroka done lonunna thama paalivaaru vachi thamaku sahaayamu cheyavalenani vaariki sangnalu chesiri; vaaru vachi rendu donelu munugunatlu nimpiri.
seemonu pethuru adhi chuchi, yesu mokaallayeduta saagilapadi prabhuvaa, nannuvidichi pommu, nenu paapaatmuda nani cheppenu.
yelayanagaa vaaru pattina chepala raashiki athadunu athanithoo koodanunna vaarandarunu vismaya mondiri.

aalaaguna seemonuthoo kooda paalivaaraina jebedayi kumaarulagu yaakobunu yohaanunu (vismaya mondiri). Anduku yesu bhayapadakumu, ippatinundi neevu manushyulanu pattuvaadavai yunduvani seemonuthoo cheppenu.
vaaru donelanu darikicherchi, samasthamunu vidichipetti aayananu vembadinchiri.

aayana yoka pattanamulo nunnappudu idigo kushtha rogamuthoo nindina yoka manushyudundenu. Vaadu yesunu chuchi, saagilapadi prabhuvaa, nee kishtamaithe nannu shuddhunigaa cheyagalavani aayananu vedukonenu.
appudaayana cheyyichaapi vaanini mutti naakishtame; neevu shuddhudavukammani anagaane, kushtharogamu vaanini vidichenu.

appudaayana neevu evanithoonu cheppaka velli, vaariki saakshyaarthamai nee dhehamunu yaajakuniki kanuparachukoni, neevu shuddhudavainanduku moshe niyaminchinattu kaanukalanu samarpinchumani agnaapinchenu.
ayithe aayananu goorchina samaachaaramu mari ekkuvagaa vyaapinchenu. Bahujana samoohamulu aayana maata vinutakunu thama rogamulanu kudurchukonutakunu koodivachu chundenu.
aayana praarthana cheyutaku aranyamu loniki velluchundenu.

okanaadaayana bodhinchuchundagaa, galilaya yoodayadheshamula prathi graamamunundiyu yeroosha lemunundiyu vachina parisayyulunu dharmashaastropadhesha kulunu koorchundiyundagaa, aayana svasthaparachunatlu prabhuvu shakthi aayanakundenu.
idigo kondaru manushyulu pakshavaayuvugala yoka manushyuni manchamumeeda mosi koni, vaanini lopaliki techi, aayana yeduta unchu taku prayatnamu chesiri gaani
janulu gumpukoodi yundi nanduna, vaanini lopaliki techutaku vallapadaka poyenu ganuka, intimeedi kekki penkulu vippi, manchamuthoo kooda yesu eduta vaari madhyanu vaanini dinchiri.
aayana vaari vishvaasamu chuchi manushyudaa, nee paapa mulu kshamimpabadiyunnavani vaanithoo cheppagaa,
shaastru lunu parisayyulunu dhevadooshana cheyuchunna yithadevadu? dhevudokkade thappa mari evadu paapamulu kshamimpagaladani aalochinchukonasaagiri.
yesu vaari aalochana lerigimeeru mee hrudayamulalo emi aalo chinchuchunnaaru?
nee paapamulu kshamimpabadi yunna vani chepputa sulabhamaa? neevu lechi naduvumani chepputa sulabhamaa?

ayithe paapamulu kshaminchutaku bhoomi meeda manushyakumaaruniki adhikaaramu kaladani meeru telisikonavalenu ani vaarithoo cheppi, pakshavaayuvu gala vaani chuchineevu lechi, nee manchametthikoni, nee yintiki vellumani neethoo cheppuchunnaananenu.
ventane vaadu vaariyeduta lechi, thaanu pandukoniyunna manchamu etthi koni, dhevuni mahimaparachuchu thana yintiki vellenu.
andarunu vismayamondinedu goppa vinthalu chuchithi mani dhevuni mahimaparachuchu bhayamuthoo nindukoniri.
atupimmata aayana bayaludheri, levi yanu oka sunkari, sunkapu mettunoddha koorchundiyunduta chuchi nannu vembadinchumani athanithoo cheppagaa
athadu samasthamunu vidichipetti, lechi, aayananu vembadinchenu.
aa levi, thana yinta aayanaku goppa vindu chesenu. Sunkarulunu itharulu anekulunu vaarithoo kooda bhojana munaku koorchundiri.
parisayyulunu vaari shaastrulunu idi chuchi sunkarulathoonu paapulathoonu meerela thini traaguchunnaarani aayana shishyulameeda sanigiri.
anduku yesurogulake gaani aarogyamugala vaariki vaidyudakkaraledu.
maarumanassu pondutakai nenu paapulanu piluvavachithini gaani neethimanthulanu piluvaraaledani vaarithoo cheppenu.
vaaraayananu chuchi yohaanu shishyulu tharachugaa upavaasapraarthanalu cheyuduru; aalaage parisayyula shishyulunu cheyuduru gaani, nee shishyulu thini traaguchunnaare ani cheppiri.
anduku yesupendli kumaarudu thamathoo unnanthakaalamu pendli inti vaari chetha meeru upavaasamu cheyimpa galaraa?
pendlikumaa rudu vaariyoddhanundi konipobadu dinamulu vachunu; aa dinamulalo vaaru upavaasamu chethurani vaarithoo cheppenu.

aayana vaarithoo oka upamaanamu cheppenu. Etlanagaa'evadunu paathabattaku krotthagudda maasikaveyadu; vesina yedala krotthadhi daanini chimpiveyunu; adhiyunugaaka krotthadaanilonundi theesina mukka paathadaanithoo kaliyadu.
evadunu paatha thitthulalo krottha draakshaarasamu poyadu; posinayedala krottha draakshaarasamu thitthulanu pigulchunu, rasamu kaaripovunu, thitthulunu paadagunu.
ayithe krottha draakshaarasamu kottha thitthulalo poyavalenu.
paatha draakshaarasamu traagi ventane krottha daanini koruvaadevadunu ledu; paathadhe manchidanunani cheppenu.
oka vishraanthidinamuna aayana pantachelalobadi vellu chundagaa, aayana shishyulu vennulu trunchi, chethulathoo nalupukoni, thinuchundiri.
appudu parisayyulalo kondaru vishraanthidinamuna cheyadaganidi meerenduku cheyuchunnaarani vaarinadugagaa
yesu vaarithoo itlanenu thaanunu thanathoo kooda unnavaarunu aakaligoni nappudu daaveedu emicheseno adhiyainanu meeru chaduva ledaa?
athadu dhevuni mandiramulo praveshinchi, yaajakulu thappa mari evarunu thinakoodani samukhapu rottelu theesikoni thini, thanathoo kooda unnavaarikini icchenu gadaa anenu.
kaagaa manushyakumaarudu vishraanthidinamunakunu yajamaanudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
mariyoka vishraanthidinamuna aayana samaajamandiramu loniki velli bodhinchuchunnappudu, akkada oocha kudi cheyyigalavaadokadundenu.
shaastrulunu parisayyulunu aayanameeda neramu mopavalenani, vishraanthidinamuna svastha parachunemo ani aayananu kanipettuchundiri;
ayithe aayana vaari aalochana lerigi, oochacheyyigalavaani thooneevu lechi madhyanu niluvumani cheppagaa, vaadu lechi nilichenu.
appudu yesuvishraanthidinamuna melucheyuta dharmamaa keeducheyuta dharmamaa? Praanarakshana dharmamaa praana hatya dharmamaa? Ani mimmu naduguchunnaanani vaarithoo cheppi
vaarinandarini chuttu kalayajoochi nee cheyyi chaapumani vaanithoo cheppenu; vaadaalaagu cheyagaane vaani cheyyi baagupadenu.
appudu vaaru verrikopamuthoo nindukoni, yesunu emi cheyu damaa ani yokanithoonokadu maatalaadukoniri.
aa dinamulayandu aayana praarthanacheyutaku kondaku velli, dhevuni praarthinchutayandu raatri gadipenu.
udayamainappudu aayana thana shishyulanu pilichi, vaarilo pandrendumandhini erparachi, vaariki aposthalulu anu peru pettenu.
veerevaranagaa aayana evaniki pethuru anu maaruperu petteno aa seemonu, athani sahodarudaina andreya, yaakobu, yohaanu, philippu, bartolomayi,
matthayi, thoomaa, alphayi kumaarudaina yaakobu, jelothe anabadina seemonu,
yaakobu sahodarudaina yoodhaa, drohiyagu iskariyothu yoodhaa anu vaaru.

aayana vaarithoo kooda digivachi maidaanamandu nilichinappudu aayana shishyula goppa samoohamunu, aayana bodha vinutakunu thama rogamulanu kudurchukonuta kunu yoodaya dheshamanthatinundiyu, yerooshalemu nundiyu, thooru seedonanu pattanamula samudra theeramula nundiyu vachina bahujanasamooha munu,
apavitraatmala chetha baadhimpabadinavaarunu vachi svasthathanondiri.
prabhaavamu aayanalonundi bayaludheri andarini svasthaparachu chundenu ganuka janasamoohamanthayu aayananu mutta valenani yatnamuchesenu.
anthata aayana thana shishyulathattu paarachuchi itlanenu beedalaina meeru dhanyulu, dhevuniraajyamu meedi.
ippudu akaligonuchunna meeru dhanyulu, meeru trupthi parachabaduduru. Ippudu edchuchunna meeru dhanyulu, meeru navvuduru.
manushyakumaaruni nimitthamu manushyulu mimmunu dveshinchi velivesi nindinchi mee peru cheddadani kottiveyunappudu meeru dhanyulu.
aa dinamandu meeru santhooshinchi ganthulu veyudi; idigo mee phalamu paralokamandu goppadai yundunu; vaari pitha rulu pravakthalaku adhe vidhamugaa chesiri.
ayyo, dhana vanthulaaraa, meeru (korina) aadharana meeru pondi yunnaaru.
ayyo yippudu (kadupu) nindiyunna vaaralaaraa, meeraakaligonduru. Ayyo yippudu navvuchunnavaaralaaraa, meeru duḥkhinchi yedthuru.
manushyulandaru mimmunu koniyaadunappudu meeku shrama; vaari pitharulu abaddhapravakthalaku adhe vidhamugaa chesiri.
vinuchunna meethoo nenu cheppunadhemanagaa mee shatruvulanu preminchudi, mimmunu dveshinchuvaariki melu cheyudi,
mimmunu shapinchuvaarini deevinchudi, mimmunu baadhinchuvaarikoraku praarthanacheyudi.
ninnu oka chempa meeda kottuvaani vaipunaku rendava chempakooda trippumu. nee paibatta etthikoni povuvaanini, nee angeeni kooda etthi konipokunda addagimpakumu.
ninnadugu prathivaanikini immu; nee sotthu etthikoni povu vaaniyoddha daani marala adugavaddu.
manushyulu meekelaagu cheyavalenani meeru koruduro aalaagu meerunu vaariki cheyudi.
mimmunu preminchuvaarine meeru preminchinayedala meekemi meppu kalugunu? Paapulunu thammunu preminchu vaarini preminthuru gadaa
meeku melu cheyuvaarike melu chesinayedala meekemi meppukalugunu? Paapulunu aalaage chethuru gadaa
meerevariyoddha marala puchukonavalenani nireekshinthuro vaarike appu ichinayedala meekemi meppu kalugunu? Paapulunu thaamichinantha marala puchukona valenani paapulaku appu icchedaru gadaa.

meeraithe etti vaarini goorchiyainanu niraasha chesikonaka mee shatruvulanu preminchudi, melucheyudi, appu iyyudi; appudu mee phalamu goppadaiyundunu, meeru sarvonnathuni kumaarulai yunduru. aayana, kruthagnathalenivaariyeda lanu dushtulayedalanu upakaariyai yunnaadu.
kaabatti mee thandri kanikaramugalavaadai yunnattu meerunu kanikaramugalavaarai yundudi.
theerpu theerchakudi, appudu mimmunu goorchi theerpu theerchabadadu; neramu mopakudi, appudu mee meeda neramu mopabadadu;

kshaminchudi, appudu meeru kshamimpabaduduru; iyyudi, appudu meekiyyabadunu; anachi, kudilinchi, digajaarunatlu nindu kolathanu manushyulu mee odilo koluthuru. meeru e kolathathoo koluthuro aa kolathathoone meeku marala koluvabadunani cheppenu.
mariyu aayana vaarithoo ee upamaanamu cheppenugruddivaadu gruddivaaniki daari choopagaladaa? Vaariddarunu guntalo paduduru gadaa.
shishyudu thana bodhakunikante adhikudu kaadu; siddhudaina prathivaadunu thana bodhakunivale undunu.
neevu nee kantilo unna doolamu enchaka nee sahodaruni kantilo unna nalusunu choodanela?

nee kantilo unna doolamunu choodaka nee sahodarunithoo sahodarudaa, nee kantilo unna nalusunu theesiveya nimmani neevelaagu cheppa galavu? Veshadhaaree, modata nee kantilo unna doola munu theesiveyumu, appudu nee sahodaruni kantilo unna nalusunu theesiveyutaku neeku thetagaa kanabadunu.
e manchi chettunanu panikimaalinaphala mulu phalimpavu, panikimaalina chettuna manchi phalamulu phalimpavu.
prathi chettu thana phalamulavalana teliyabadunu. Mundlapodalo anjoorapu pandlu erukonaru; korinda podalo draakshapandlu koyaru.

sajjanudu, thana hruda yamanu manchi dhananidhi lonundi sadvishayamulanu baya tiki techunu; durjanudu chedda dhananidhilonundi durvishaya mulanu bayatiki techunu. Hrudayamu nindiyundu daaninibatti yokani noru maatalaadunu.
nenu cheppu maatala prakaaramu meeru cheyaka prabhuvaa prabhuvaa, ani nannu piluchuta enduku?
naa yoddhaku vachi, naa maatalu vini vaatichoppuna cheyu prathivaadunu evani poliyunduno meeku teliya jethunu.

vaadu illu kattavalenani yundi lothugaa travvi, bandameeda punaadhi vesinavaani poli yundunu. Varadavachi pravaahamu aa yintimeeda vadigaa kottinanu, adhi baagugaa kattabadinanduna daani kadalimpalekapoyenu.
ayithe naa maatalu viniyu cheyanivaadu punaadhi veyaka nelameeda illu kattina vaanini poliyundunu. Pravaahamu daanimeeda vadigaa kottagaane adhi koolipadenu; aa yintipaatu goppadani cheppenu.
aayana thana maatalanniyu prajalaku sampoorthigaa vinipinchina tharuvaatha kapernahoomuloniki vacchenu.
oka shathaadhipathiki priyudaina daasudokadu rogiyai chaava siddhamaiyundenu.
shathaadhipathi yesunugoorchi vini, aayana vachi thana daasuni svasthaparachavalenani aayananu vedukonutaku yoodula peddalanu aayana yoddhaku pampenu.
vaaru yesunoddhaku vachineevalana ee melu pondutaku athadu yogyudu;
athadu mana janulanu preminchi manaku samaajamandiramu thaane kattinchenani aayanathoo cheppi mikkili bathimaalu koniri.

kaavuna yesu vaarithoo kooda vellenu. aayana aa yintidaggaraku vachinappudu shathaadhipathi thana snehithulanu chuchimee raayanayoddhaku velliprabhuvaa, shrama puchukonavaddu; neevu naa yintiloniki vachutaku nenu paatrudanukaanu.
anduchetha neeyoddhaku vachutaku paatrudanani nenu enchakonaledu; ayithe maatamaatramu selavimmu, appudu naa daasudu svasthaparachabadunu,

nenu sahaa adhikaaramunaku lobadinavaadanu; naa chethikrindanu sainikulu unnaaru; nenokani pommante povunu, okani rammante vachunu, naadaasuni cheyumante idi cheyunani nenu cheppinattu aayanathoo cheppudani vaarini pampenu.
yesu ee maatalu vini, athanigoorchi aashcharyapadi, thanaventa vachuchunna janasamoohamu vaipu thirigi ishraayelulo nainanu intha goppa vishvaasamu nenu choodaledani meethoo cheppuchunnaananenu.
pampabadina vaaru intiki thirigivachi, aa daasudu svasthudai yunduta kanugoniri.
ventane aayana naayeenanu oka ooriki vellu chundagaa, aayana shishyulunu bahu janasamoohamunu aayanathoo kooda velluchundiri.

aayana aa oori gaviniyoddhaku vachi nappudu, chanipoyina yokadu velupaliki mosikoni pobaduchundenu; athani thalliki athadokkade kumaarudu, aame vidhavaraalu; aa oori janulu anekulu aamethoo kooda undiri.
prabhuvu aamenu chuchi aameyandukanikarapadi - eduvavaddani aamethoo cheppi, daggaraku vachi paadenu muttagaa moyuchunnavaaru nilichiri.
aayana chinnavaadaa, lemmani neethoo cheppuchunnaananagaa
aa chanipoyina vaadu lechi koorchundi maatalaadasaagenu; aayana athanini athani thalliki appaginchenu.
andaru bhayaakraanthulai manalo goppa pravaktha bayaludheri yunnaadaniyu, dhevudu thana prajalaku darshanamanu grahinchi yunnaadaniyu dhevuni mahimaparachiri.
aayananugoorchina yee samaachaaramu yoodaya yandanthatanu chuttupatla pradheshamandanthatanu vyaapinchenu.
yohaanu shishyulu ee sangathulanniyu athaniki teliyajesiri.
anthata yohaanu thana shishyulalo iddarini pilichi raabovuvaadavu neevenaa? Memu mariyokani koraku kanipettavalenaa? Ani adugutaku vaarini prabhuvu noddhaku pampenu.
aa manushyulu aayanayoddhaku vachi raabovuvaadavu neevenaa? Leka mariyokanikoraku memu kanipettavalenaa? Ani adugu taku baapthismamichu yohaanu mammunu neeyoddhaku pampenani cheppiri.
aa gadiyalone aayana rogamulunu, baadhalunu, apavitraatmalunugala anekulanu svasthaparachi, chaalamandi gruddivaariki choopu daya chesenu.

appudaayana meeru velli, kannavaatini vinna vaatini yohaanuku telupudi. Gruddivaaru choopu pondu chunnaaru, kuntivaaru naduchuchunnaaru, kushtha rogulu shuddhulaguchunnaaru,chevitivaaru vinuchunnaaru, chanipoyinavaaru lepabaduchunnaaru, beedalaku suvaartha praka timpabaduchunnadhi;
naa vishayamai abhyantharapadani vaadu dhanyudanivaariki uttharamicchenu.
yohaanu doothalu vellina tharuvaatha, aayana yohaanunugoorchi janasamoohamulathoo eelaagu cheppasaagenumeeremi choochutaku aranyamuloniki vellithiri? Gaaliki kadaluchunna rellunaa?
maremi chooda vellithiri? Sannapu battalu dharinchukonina vaaninaa? Idigo prashasthavastramulu dharinchukoni, sukhamugaa jeevinchuvaaru raajagruhamulalo unduru.
ayithe maremi choodavellithiri? Pravakthanaa? Avunugaani pravakthakante goppavaaninani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
idigo nenu naa doothanu neeku mundhugaa pampu chunnaanu, athadu nee mundhara nee maargamu siddha parachunu ani yevarinigoorchi vraayabadeno athade yee yohaanu.
streelu kaninavaarilo yohaanukante goppavaadevadunu ledu. Ayinanu dhevuni raajyamulo alpudainavaadu athanikante goppavaadani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
prajalandarunu sunkarulunu (yohaanu bodha) vini, athadichina baapthismamu pondinavaarai, dhevudu nyaayavanthudani yoppukoniri gaani
parisayyulunu dharmashaastropadheshakulunu athanichetha baapthismamu pondaka, thama vishayamaina dhevuni sankalpamunu niraakarinchiri.
kaabatti yee tharamu manushyulanu nenu dhenithoo polchu dunu, vaaru dhenini poliyunnaaru?

santhaveedhulalo koorchundiyundi meeku pillanagrovi oodithivi gaani meeru naatyamaadaraithiri; pralaapinchithivi gaani meeredva raithiri ani yokanithoo okadu cheppukoni pilupulaata laadukonu pillakaayalanu poliyunnaaru.
baapthisma michu yohaanu, rotte thinakayu draakshaarasamu traaga kayu vacchenu ganukaveedu dayyamupattinavaadani mee ranuchunnaaru.
manushya kumaarudu thinuchunu, traaguchunu vacchenu ganuka meeru'idigo veedu thindipothunu madyapaaniyu, sunkarulakunu paapulakunu snehithu dunu anu chunnaaru.
ayinanu gnaanamu gnaanamani daani sambandhulandarinibatti theerpupondunanenu.
parisayyulalo okadu thanathoo kooda bhojanamu cheyavalenani aayananadigenu. aayana aa parisayyuni yintiki velli, bhojanapankthini koorchundagaa
aa oorilo unna paapaatmuraalaina yoka stree, yesu parisayyuni yinta bhojanamunaku koorchunnaadani telisikoni, yoka buddilo attharu theesikonivachi
venukathattu aayana paadamulayoddha niluvabadi, yedchuchu kanneellathoo aayana paadamulanu thadipi, thana thalavendrukalathoo thudichi, aayana paadamulanu muddupettukoni, aa attharu vaatiki poosenu.
aayananu pilichina parisayyudu adhi chuchi'eeyana pravakthayaina yedala thannu muttukonina yee stree evateyo etuvantido yerigiyundunu; idi paapaatmu raalu ani thanalo thaananukonenu.
anduku yesuseemonoo, neethoo oka maata cheppavalenani yunnaanani athanithoo anagaa athadubodhakudaa, cheppumanenu.
appudu yesu appu ichu okaniki iddaru runasthu lundiri. Vaarilo okadu aiduvandala dhenaaramulunu mariyokadu ebadhi dhenaaramulunu achiyundiri.
aa appu theerchutaku vaariyoddha emiyu lekapoyenu ganuka athadu vaariddarini kshaminchenu. Kaabatti veerilo evadu athani ekkuvagaa preminchuno cheppumani adigenu.
anduku seemonu athadevaniki ekkuva kshamincheno vaade ani naakuthoochuchunnadani cheppagaa aayananeevu sarigaa yochinchithivani athanithoo cheppi

aa stree vaipu thirigi, seemonuthoo itlanenu ee streeni choochuchunnaane, nenu nee yintiloniki raagaa neevu naa paadamulaku neelliyya ledu gaani, yeeme thana kanneellathoo naa paadamulanu thadipi thana thalavendrukalathoo thudichenu.
neevu nannu muddupettukonaledu gaani, nenu lopaliki vachi nappati nundi yeeme naa paadamulu muddupettu konuta maana ledu.
neevu noonethoo naa thala antaledu gaani eeme naa paadamulaku attharu poosenu.
aame visthaaramugaa preminchenu ganuka aameyokka visthaara paapamulu kshaminchabadenani neethoo cheppuchunnaanu. Evaniki konche mugaa kshamimpabaduno, vaadu konchemugaa preminchunani cheppi
nee paapamulu kshamimpa badiyunnavi ani aamethoo anenu.
appudaayanathoo kooda bhojana pankthini koorchundina vaarupaapamulu kshaminchuchunna yithadevadani thamalothaamu anu konasaagiri.
andukaayana nee vishvaasamu ninnu rakshinchenu, samaadhaanamu galadaanavai vellumani aa streethoo cheppenu.
ventane aayana dhevuni raajyasuvaarthanu telupuchu, prakatinchuchu, prathi pattanamulonu prathi graamamulonu sanchaaramu cheyuchundagaa

pandrendumandi shishyulunu, apavitraatmalunu vyaadhulunu pogottabadina kondaru streelunu, anagaa edu dayyamulu vadalipoyina magdalene anabadina mariyayu, herodu yokka gruhanirvaahakudagu koojaa bhaaryayagu yohannayu, soosannayu aayanathoo kooda undiri.
veerunu itharu lanekulunu, thamaku kaligina aasthithoo vaariki upachaaramu cheyuchu vachiri.
bahu janasamoohamu koodi prathi pattanamunundi aayanayoddhaku vachuchundagaa aayana upamaanareethigaa itlanenu
vitthuvaadu thana vitthanamulu vitthutaku bayalu dherenu. Athadu vitthuchundagaa, konni vitthanamulu trova prakkanu padi trokkabadenu ganuka, aakaashapakshulu vaatini mingivesenu.
mari konni raathinelanupadi, molichi, chemmalenanduna endi poyenu.
mari konni mundlapodala naduma padenu; mundlapodalu vaatithoo molichi vaati nanachivesenu.
marikonni manchinelanupadenu; avi molichi nooranthalugaa phalinchenanenu. ee maatalu palukuchuvinutaku chevulu galavaadu vinunu gaaka ani biggaragaa cheppenu.
aayana shishyulu ee upamaanabhaavamemitani aayananu adugagaa
aayanadhevuni raajyamarmamu leruguta meeku anugrahimpabadiyunnadhi; itharulaithe chuchiyu choodakayu, viniyu grahimpakayu undunatlu vaariki upamaanareethigaa (bodhimpabadu chunnavi.)
ee upamaana bhaavamemanagaa, vitthanamu dhevuni vaakyamu.
trova prakkanunduvaaru, vaaru vinuvaaru gaani nammi rakshana pondakundunatlu apavaadhi vachi vaari hrudayamulo nundi vaakyametthi koni povunu.
raathinelanundu vaarevaranagaa, vinu nappudu vaakyamunu santhooshamugaa angeekarinchuvaaru gaani vaariki veru lenanduna konchemu kaalamu nammi shodhanakaalamuna tolagipovuduru.

mundla podalalo padina (vitthanamunu polina) vaarevaranagaa, vini kaalamu gadichinakoladhi yee jeevanasambandhamaina vichaaramula chethanu dhanabhogamulachethanu anachiveyabadi paripakvamugaa phalimpanivaaru.
manchi nela nundu (vitthanamunu polina) vaarevaranagaa yogya maina manchi manassuthoo vaakyamu vini daanini avalambinchi opikathoo phalinchuvaaru.
evadunu deepamu muttinchi paatrathoo kappiveyadu, manchamu krinda pettadu gaani, lopaliki vachuvaariki velugu agapadavalenani deepasthambhamumeeda daanini pettunu.
thetaparachabadani rahasyamediyu ledu; teliyajeya badakayu bayalupadakayu nundu marugainadhediyu ledu.
kaliginavaaniki iyyabadunu, lenivaaniyoddhanundi thanaku kaladani anukonunadhikooda theesiveyabadunuganuka meerelaagu vinuchunnaaro choochukonudani cheppenu.
aayana thalliyu sahodarulunu aayanayoddhaku vachi, janulu gumpugaa undutachetha aayanadaggaraku raaleka poyiri.
appudunee thalliyu nee sahodarulunu ninnu choodagori velupala nilichiyunnaarani yevaro aayanaku teliyajesiri.
andukaayanadhevuni vaakyamu vini, daani prakaaramu jariginchu veere naa thalliyu naa sahodarulunani vaarithoo cheppenu.
mariyokanaadu aayana thana shishyulathookooda oka doneyekki sarassu addariki podamani vaarithoo cheppagaa, vaaru aa donenu trosi bayaludheriri.
vaaru vellu chundagaa aayana nidrinchenu. Anthalo gaalivaana sarassumeediki vachi done neellathoo nindinanduna vaaru apaayakaramaina sthithilo undiri
ganuka aayana yoddhaku vachiprabhuvaa prabhuvaa, nashinchipovuchunnaa mani cheppi aayananu lepiri. aayana lechi, gaalini neetipongunu gaddimpagaane avi anagi nimmalamaa yenu.

appudaayana mee vishvaasamekkada ani vaarithoo anenu. Ayithe vaaru bhayapadi eeyana gaalikini neellakunu aagnaapimpagaa avi lobaduchunnave; eeyana yevaro ani yokanithoo nokadu cheppukoni aashcharyapadi
vaaru galilayaku edurugaa undu geraseeneeyula dheshamunaku vachiri.
aayana odduna diginappudu aa oorivaadokadu aayanaku edurugaavacchenu. Vaadu dayyamulupattinavaadai, bahukaalamunundi battalu kattu konaka, samaadhulalonegaani yintilo unduvaadu kaadu.
vaadu yesunu chuchi, kekaluvesi aayana yeduta saagilapadiyesoo, sarvonnathudaina dhevuni kumaarudaa, naathoo neekemi? Nannu baadhaparachakumani ninnu vedukonuchunnaanu ani kekaluvesi cheppenu.

yelayanagaa aayana'aa manushyuni vidichi velupaliki rammani aa apavitraatmaku aagnaapinchenu. adhi aneka paryaayamulu vaanini pattuchuvacchenu ganuka vaanini golusulathoonu kaalisankellathoonu katti kaavaliyandunchiri gaani, vaadu bandhakamulanu tempagaa dayyamu vaanini adaviloniki tharumukoni poyenu.
yesunee peremani vaani nadugagaa, chaala dayyamulu vaanilo cochiyundenu ganuka,
vaadu thana peru sena ani cheppi, paathaalamuloniki povutaku thamaku aagnaapimpavaddani aayananu vedukonenu.
akkada visthaaramaina pandula manda kondameeda meyu chundenu ganuka, vaatilo cochutaku thamaku selavimmani aayananu vedukonagaa aayana selavicchenu.
appudu dayyamulu aa manushyuni vidichipoyi pandulalo cocchenu ganuka, aa manda prapaathamunundi sarassuloniki vadigaa parugetthi oopiri thirugaka chacchenu.
mepuchunnavaaru jariginadaanini chuchi, paaripoyi aa pattanamulonu graamamulalonu aa sangathi teliyajesiri.
janulu jariginadaanini choodavelli, yesunoddhaku vachi, dayyamulu vadalipoyina manushyudu battalu kattukoni, svasthachitthudai yesu paadamulayoddha koorchunduta chuchi bhayapadiri.
adhi chuchinavaaru dayyamulu pattinavaadelaagu svasthathapondeno janulaku teliyajeyagaa
geraseeneeyula prantamulalonundu janulandaru bahu bhakrantulairi ganuka tammunu vidicipommani ayananu vedukoniri.
ayana done yekki tirigi velluchundaga, dayyamulu vadalipoyina manushyudu, ayanatho kooda tannu undanimmani ayananu vedukonenu.

ayite ayana - nivu ni yintiki tirigi velli, devudu niketti goppakaryamulu cheseno teliya jeyumani vanito cheppi vaanini pampivesenu; vadu velli yesu tanaketti goppakaaryamulu cheseno aa pattana mandanthatanu prakatinchenu.
janasamoohamu ayanakoraku eduruchoochu chundenu ganuka yesu tirigivaccinappudu vaaru aayananu cherchukoniri.
antata idigo samaaja mandirapu adhikaariyaina yaayeeru anu okadu vacci yesu paadamulameeda padi
yinchumincu pandrendendla yeedugala tana kumaarthe chaava siddhamuga unnadi ganuka tana yintiki rammani aayananu batimalukonenu. ayana velluchundagaa janasamoohamulu aayanameeda paduchundiri.
appudu pandrendendlanundi raktasraava rogamugala yoka stree yevanichetanu svasthatanondanidai aayana venukaku vachi
ayana vastrapuchengu muttenu, ventane ame raktasraavamu nilicipoyenu.
nannu muttinadi evarani yesu adugagaa andarunu - merugamannappudu, pethuru - yelinavada, janasamoohamulu krikkirisi nimeeda paduchunnaaranagaa
yesu - evado nannu muttenu, prabhavamu naalonundi vedali poyinadani, naaku telisinadanenu.

taanu marugai yundaledani, aa stree chuchi, vanakuchu vachi aayana yeduta saagilapadi, taanu endhunimittamu aayananu mutteno, ventane taanu yelaagu svasthapadeno aa sangati prajalandariyeduta teliyajeppenu.
andukaayana kumaari, nee visvaasamu ninnu svasthaparachenu, samaadhaanamu galadaanavaipommani aameto cheppenu.
ayana inkanu mataladuchundagaa samaajamandirapu adhikaari yintanundi yokadu vachi - nee kumarte chani poyinadi, bodhakuni sramapettavaddani atanito cheppenu
yesu aa maatavini - bhayapadavaddu, nammikamaatramunchumu, aame svasthaparacha badunani atanito cheppi
yintiki vachinappudu peturu yohanu yakobu anu vaarini aa chinnadani talidandrulanu thappa marevarini aayana lopaliki raaniyyaledu.
andarunu aame nimittamai yedchuchu rommu kottukonuchundagaa, aayana vaarito - yedvavaddu, aame nidrinchuchunnade gaani chanipoledani cheppenu.
aame chanipoyenani vaarerigi aayananu apahasinchiri.
ayithe aayana aame cheyyipattukoni chinnadaanaa, lemmani cheppagaa
aame praanamu thirigi vacchenu ganuka ventane aame lechenu. Appudaayana aameku bhojanamu pettudani aagnaapinchenu.
aame thalidandrulu vismayamu nondiri. Anthata aayana-jariginadhi evanithoonu cheppavaddani vaarikaagnaapinchenu.
aayana thana pandrendumandi (shishyulanu) pilichi, samasthamaina dayyamulameeda shakthini adhikaaramunu, rogamulu svasthaparachu varamunu vaarikanugrahinchi
dhevuni raajyamunu prakatinchutakunu rogulanu svasthaparachutakunu vaari nampenu.
mariyu aayanameeru prayaanamu koraku chethikarranainanu jaalenainanu rottenainanu vendinainanu mari dheninainanu theesikoni povaddu; rendu angeelu unchu konavaddu.
meeru e yinta praveshinthuro aa yintane basachesi akkadanundi bayaludherudi.
mimmunu evaru cherchukonaro aa pattanamulonundi bayaludherunappudu vaarimeeda saakshyamugaa undutaku mee paadadhooli dulipiveyudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
vaaru bayaludheri anthatanu suvaartha prakatinchuchu, (rogulanu) svasthaparachuchu graamamulalo sanchaaramu chesiri.
chathurthaadhipathiyaina herodu jarigina kaaryamu lannitini goorchi vini, yetuthoochaka yundenu. yelayanagaa kondaru yohaanu mruthulalonundi lechenaniyu,
kondaru eleeyaa kanabadenaniyu; kondaru poorva kaalapu pravakthayokadu lechenaniyu cheppukonuchundiri.
appudu herodu nenu yohaanunu thala gottinchithini gadaa; yevanigoorchi yitti sangathulu vinuchunnaano athadevado ani cheppi aayananu choodagorenu.
aposthalulu thirigi vachi, thaamu chesinavanniyu aayanaku teliyajeyagaa, aayana vaarini venta bettukoni betsayidaa anu ooriki ekaanthamugaa vellenu.
jana samoohamulu adhi telisikoni aayananu vembadimpagaa, aayana vaarini cherchukoni, dhevuni raajyamunugoorchi vaarithoo maatalaaduchu, svasthatha kaavalasinavaarini svastha parachenu.

proddu grunka naarambhinchinappudu pandrenduguru shishyulu vachi manamee aranyamulo unnaamu ganuka chuttupatlanunna graamamulakunu pallelakunu velli basa choochukoni, aahaaramu sampaadhinchu konunatlu janasamooha munu pampiveyumani aayanathoo cheppiri.

aayanameere vaariki bhojanamu pettudani vaarithoo cheppagaa vaarumanayoddha ayidu rottelunu rendu chepalunu thappa maremiyu ledu; memu velli yee prajalandarikoraku bhojanapadaarthamulanu koni tetthumaa ani cheppiri.
vachinavaaru inchuminchu ayiduvela mandi purushulu. aayanavaarini ebadhesimandi choppuna pankthulu theerchi koorchundabettudani thana shishyulathoo cheppagaa,
vaaraalaagu chesi andarini koorchundabettiri.
anthata aayana aa ayidu rottelanu rendu chepalanu etthikoni, aakaashamu vaipu kannu letthi vaatini aasheervadhinchi, virichi, janasamoohamu naku vaddinchutakai shishyulakicchenu.
vaarandaru thini trupthi pondina tharuvaatha migilina mukkalu pandrendu gampelletthiri.
okappudaayana ontarigaa praarthana cheyuchundagaa aayana shishyulu aayanayoddha undiri. Nenevadanani janasamoohamulu cheppukonuchunnaarani aayana vaari nadugagaa
vaaru baapthismamichu yohaananiyu, kondaru eleeyaayaniyu, kondarupoorvakaalapu pravaktha yokadu lechenaniyu cheppu konuchunnaaraniri.
andukaayana meeraithe nenevadanani cheppukonuchunnaarani vaarinadugagaa pethuruneevu dhevuni kreesthuvanenu.
aayana idi evanithoonu cheppavaddani vaariki khandithamugaa aagnaapinchi
manushyakumaarudu bahu shramalu pondi, peddala chethanu pradhaana yaajakulachethanu shaastrulachethanu visarjimpabadi, champabadi, moodava dinamuna lechuta agatya mani cheppenu.
mariyu aayana andarithoo itlanenu evadainanu nannu vembadimpa gorinayedala thannuthaanu upekshinchukoni, prathidinamu thana siluvanu etthikoni nannu vembadimpavalenu.
thana praanamunu rakshinchukona goruvaadu daanini pogottukonunu, naa nimitthamai thana praanamunu pogottukonuvaadu daanini rakshinchu konunu.
okadu lokamanthayu sampaadhinchi, thannu thaanu pogottu koninayedala, leka nashtaparachukoninayedala vaanikemi prayojanamu?
nannu goorchiyu naa maatalanu goorchiyu siggupaduvaadevado vaani goorchi manushya kumaarudu, thanakunu thana thandrikini parishudda doothalakunu kaligiyunna mahimathoo vachunappudu siggupadunu.
ikkada nilichiyunna vaarilo kondaru dhevuni raajyamunu choochuvaraku maranamu ruchichoodarani nenu meethoo nijamugaa cheppuchunnaananenu.
ee maatalu cheppinadhi modalukoni ramaarami yeni midi dinamulaina tharuvaatha, aayana pethurunu yohaanunu yaakobunu ventabettukoni, praarthanacheyutaku oka konda yekkenu.
aayana praarthinchu chundagaa aayana mukharoopamu maarenu; aayana vastramulu tellanivai dhagadhaga merisenu.
mariyu iddaru purushulu aaya nathoo maatalaaduchundiri, vaaru moshe eleeyaa anu vaaru.
vaaru mahimathoo agapadi, aayana yerooshalemulo neraverchabovu nirgamamunugoorchi maatalaadu chundiri.
pethurunu athanithoo kooda unnavaarunu nidra matthugaa undiri. Vaaru melukoninappudu, aayana mahimanu aayanathoo kooda nilichiyunna yiddaru puru shulanu chuchiri.

(aa yiddaru purushulu) aayanayoddha nundi vellipovuchundagaa pethuru yesuthoo elinavaadaa, manamikkada unduta manchidi, neeku okatiyu mosheku okatiyu eleeyaaku okatiyu moodu parna shaalalu memukattudumani, thaanu cheppinadhi thaanerugakaye cheppenu.
athadeelaagu maatalaaduchundagaa meghamokati vachi vaarini kammenu; vaaru aa meghamulo praveshinchinappudu shishyulu bhayapadiri.
mariyu eeyana ne nerparachukonina naa kumaarudu,eeyana maata vinudani yoka shabdamu aa meghamulonundi puttenu.
aa shabdamu vachina tharuvaatha yesu maatrame agapadenu. thaamu chuchina vaatilo okatiyu aa dinamulalo evarikini teliya jeyaka vaaru oorakundiri.
marunaadu vaaru aa konda digi vachinappudu bahu janasamoohamu aayanaku edurugaa vacchenu.
idigo aa janasamoohamulo okadu bodhakudaa, naa kumaaruni kataakshinchumani ninnu vedukonuchunnaanu. Vaadu naa kokkade kumaarudu.
idigo oka dayyamu vaani pattunu, pattinappudu vaadu akasmaatthugaa kekalu veyunu; nurugu kaarunatlu adhi vaanini vilavilalaadiṁ chuchu gaayaparachuchu vaanini vadali vadala kundunu.
daanini vellagottudani nee shishyulanu vedukontini gaani vaarichetha kaaledani morrapettukonenu.
anduku yesu vishvaasamuleni moorkhatharamu vaaralaaraa, nenenthakaalamu meethoo kooda undi mimmunu sahinthunu? nee kumaaruni ikkadiki theesikoni rammani cheppenu.
vaadu vachu chundagaa aa dayyamu vaanini padadrosi, vilavilalaadiṁ chenu; yesu aa apavitraatmanu gaddinchi baaluni svastha parachi vaani thandri kappaginchenu.
ganuka andaru dhevuni mahaatmyamunu chuchi aashcharyapadiri.

aayana chesina kaaryamulannitini chuchi andaru aashcharya paduchundagaa aayana ee maatalu mee chevulalo naataniyyudi. Manushyakumaarudu manushyula chethiki appagimpabadabovuchunnaadani thana shishyulathoo cheppenu.
ayithe vaaraamaata grahimpa kundunatlu adhi vaariki marugu cheyabadenu ganuka vaaru daanini telisikonaledu; mariyu aa maatanugoorchi vaaru aayananu aduga verachiri.
thamalo evadu goppavaado ani vaarilo tharkamu puttagaa
yesu vaari hrudayaalochana erigi, oka chinna biddanu theesikoni thanayoddha niluvabetti.

ee chinna biddanu naa perata cherchukonuvaadu nannu cherchukonunu, nannu cherchukonuvaadu nannu pampinavaanini cherchukonunu, mee andarilo evadu atyalpudai yunduno vaade goppa vaadani vaarithoo cheppenu.
yohaanu'elinavaadaa, yevado yokadu nee perata dayyamulanu vellagottagaa memu chuchithivi; vaadu manalanu vembadinchuvaadu kaadu ganuka vaanini aatanka parachithimani cheppenu.
anduku yesu meeru vaani naatankaparachakudi? meeku virodhi kaani vaadu mee pakshamuna nunnavaade ani athanithoo cheppenu.
aayana paramunaku cherchukonabadu dinamulu paripoorna maguchunnappudu
aayana yerooshalemunaku vellutaku manassu sthiraparachukoni, thanakante mundhugaa doothalanu pampenu. Vaaru velli aayanaku basa siddhamu cheyavale nani samarayula yoka graamamulo praveshinchiri gaani
aayana yerooshalemunaku vella nabhimukhudainanduna vaa raayananu cherchukonaledu.
shishyulaina yaakobunu yohaanunu adhi chuchi prabhuvaa, aakaashamunundi agni digi veerini naashanamu cheyunatlu memaagnaapinchuta neekishtamaa ani adugagaa,
aayana vaarithattu thirigi vaarini gaddinchenu.
anthata vaaru mariyoka graamamunaku velliri.
vaaru maargamuna velluchundagaa okadunee vekkadiki vellinanu nee venta vacchedhanani aayanathoo cheppenu.
anduku yesunakkalaku boriyalunu aakaashapakshulaku nivaasamulunu kalavu gaani manushya kumaaruniki thalavaalchu konutakainanu sthalamu ledani athanithoo cheppenu.
aayana mariyokanithoo naa ventarammani cheppenu. Athadu nenu velli modata naa thandrini paathipetti vachutaku selavimmani manavi chesenu
andukaayana mruthulu thama mruthulanu paathipettukonanimmu; neevu velli dhevuni raajya munu prakatinchumani vaanithoo cheppenu.
mariyokadu prabhuvaa, nee venta vacchedanu gaani naa yinta nunna vaariyoddha selavu theesikoni vachutaku modata naaku selavimmani adugagaa
yesunaagati meeda cheyyipetti venukathattu choochu vaadevadunu dhevuni raajyamunaku paatrudukaadani vaanithoo cheppenu.
atutharuvaatha prabhuvu debbadhimandi yitharulanu niyaminchi, thaanu vellabovu prathi oorikini prathichootikini thanakante mundu iddariddarinigaa pampenu.
pampinappu daayana vaarithoo itlanenukotha visthaaramugaa unnadhi gaani panivaaru koddimandiye; kaabatti kotha yajamaanuni thana kothaku panivaarini pampa vedukonudi.
meeru velludi; idigo thoodellamadhyaku gorra pillalanu pampinattu nenu mimmunu pampuchunnaanu.
meeru sanchinainanu jaalenainanu cheppulanainanu theesi konipovaddu;
trovalo evani nainanu kushalaprashna laduga vaddu; meeru e yintanainanu praveshinchunappudu'ee yintiki samaadhaanamagu gaaka ani modata cheppudi.
samaadhaanapaatrudu akkada nundinayedala mee samaadhaanamu athanimeeda niluchunu; leniyedala adhi meeku thirigi vachunu.
vaaru meekichu padaarthamulanu thinuchu traaguchu aa yintilone yundudi, panivaadu thana jeethamunaku paatrudu. Intiṁ tiki thirugavaddu.
mariyu meeru e pattanamulonaina praveshinchunappudu vaaru mimmunu cherchukonte mee mundharapettunavi thinudi.
andulo nunna rogulanu svasthaparachudi dhevuni raajyamu mee daggaraku vachiyunna dani vaarithoo cheppudi.
meeru e pattanamulonaina praveshinchunappudu vaaru mimmunu cherchukonaka poyina yedala
meeru daani veedhulaloniki poyimaa paadamulaku antina mee pattanapu dhoolinikooda mee yedutane dulipiveyuchunnaamu; ayinanu dhevuni raajyamu sameepinchi yunnadani telisikonudani cheppudi.
aa pattanapu gathikante sodoma pattanapu gathi aa dinamuna orvathaginadai yundunani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.

ayyo koraajeenaa, ayyo betsayidaa, mee madhya cheyabadina adbhuthamulu thooru seedonu pattana mulalo cheyabadinayedala aa pattanamulavaaru poorvame gonepatta kattukoni boodide vesikoni koorchundi maaru manassu pondhi yundhuru.
ayinanu vimarshakaalamu nandu mee gathikante thooru seedonu pattanamulavaari gathi orvadaginadai yundunu.
o kapernahoomaa, aakaashamu mattuku hechimpabadedavaa? neevu paathaalamuvaraku digipoyedavu.
mee maata vinuvaadu naa maata vinunu, mimmunu niraakarinchuvaadu nannu niraakarinchunu, nannu niraakarinchuvaadu nannu pampinavaanini niraakarinchunanenu.
aa debbadhimandi shishyulu santhooshamuthoo thirigi vachi prabhuvaa, dayyamulu kooda nee naamamuvalana maaku lobaduchunnavani cheppagaa
aayana saathaanu merupu vale aakaashamunundi paduta chuchithini.
idigo paamulanu thellanu trokkutakunu shatruvu balamanthatimeedanu meeku adhikaaramu anugrahinchiyunnaanu; ediyu mee kenthamaatramunu haanicheyadu.
ayinanu dayyamulu meeku lobaduchunnavani santhooshimpaka mee perulu paralokamandu vraayabadi yunnavani santhooshinchudani vaarithoo cheppenu.

aa gadiyalone yesu parishuddhaatmayandu bahugaa aanandinchi-thandree, aakaashamunakunu bhoomikini prabhuvaa, neevu gnaanulakunu vivekulakunu ee sangathulanu marugu chesi pasibaaluraku bayalu parachinaavani ninnu sthuthinchu chunnaanu; avunu thandree, aalaagu nee drushtiki anukoola maayenu.

samasthamunu naa thandrichetha naaku appagimpa badiyunnadhi; kumaarudevado, thandri thappa marevadunu erugadu; thandri evado, kumaarudunu kumaarudevaniki aayananu bayalu parachanuddheshinchuno vaadunu thappa, marevadunu erugadani cheppenu.
appudaayana thana shishyulavaipu thirigi-meeru choochuchunna vaatini choochu kannulu dhanyamulainavi;
anekamandi pravakthalunu raajulunu, meeru choochuchunnavi choodagori choodakayu, vinagori vinakayu undirani meethoo cheppuchunnaanani yekaanthamandu vaarithoo anenu.
idigo okappudu dharmashaastropa dheshakudokadu lechi bodhakudaa, nityajeevamunaku vaarasudanagutaku nenemi cheyavalenani aayananu shodhinchuchu adigenu.
andukaayana dharmashaastramandhemi vraayabadiyunnadhi? nee vemi chaduvuchunnaavani athani nadugagaa

athadu - nee dhevudaina prabhuvunu nee poorna hrudayamuthoonu, nee poorna manassuthoonu, nee poorna shakthithoonu, nee poorna vivekamuthoonu premimpavalenaniyu, ninnuvale nee poruguvaani premimpavalenaniyu, vraayabadi yunnadani cheppenu.
andukaayana neevu sarigaa uttharamichithivi; aalaagu cheyumu appudu jeevinchedavani athanithoo cheppenu.
ayithe thaanu neethimanthudainattu kanabarachukonagori, athadu avunu gaani naa poruguvaadevadani yesunadi genu.
anduku yesu itlanenu'oka manushyudu yerooshalemu nundi yerikopattanamunaku digi velluchu dongala chethilo chikkenu; vaaru athani battalu dochukoni, athani kotti korapraanamuthoo vidichi
appudoka yaajakudu aa trovanu velluta thatasthinchenu. Athadu athanini chuchi, prakkagaa poyenu.
aalaagunane leveeyudokadu aa chootikivachi chuchi prakkagaa poyenu.
ayithe oka samarayudu prayaanamai povuchu, athadu padiyunnachootiki vachi

athanini chuchi, athanimeeda jaalipadi, daggarakupoyi, nooneyu draakshaarasamunu posi athani gaayamulanu katti, thana vaahanamumeeda ekkinchi yoka pootakoollavaani yintiki theesikonipoyi athani paraamarshinchenu.

marunaadathadu rendu dhenaaramulu theesi aa poota koollavaanikichi ithani paraamarshinchumu, neevinke mainanu kharchu chesinayedala nenu marala vachunappudu adhi neeku theerchedhanani athanithoo cheppi poyenu.
kaagaa dongalachethilo chikkinavaaniki ee muggurilo evadu poruguvaadaayenani neeku thoochu chunnadhi ani yesu adugagaa athadu- athanimeeda jaali padinavaade anenu.
anduku yesu neevunu velli aalaagu cheyumani athanithoo cheppenu.
anthata vaaru prayaanamai povuchundagaa, aayana yoka graamamulo praveshinchenu. Maartha anu oka stree aayananu thana yinta cherchukonenu.
aameku mariya anu sahodariyundenu. eeme yesu paadamulayoddha koorchundi aayana bodhavinu chundenu.

maartha visthaaramaina pani pettukonutachetha tondharapadi, aayanayoddhaku vachiprabhuvaa, nenu ontarigaa panicheyutaku naa sahodari nannu vidichi pettinanduna, neeku chinthaledaa? Naaku sahaayamu cheyumani aamethoo cheppumanenu.
anduku prabhuvu maarthaa, maarthaa, neevanekamaina panulanu goorchi vichaara mukaligi tondharapaduchunnaavu gaani avasaramainadhi okkate
mariya utthamamainadaanini erparachukonenu, adhi aame yoddhanundi theesiveyabadadani aamethoo cheppenu.

aayana yoka choota praarthana cheyuchundenu. Praarthana chaalinchina tharuvaatha aayana shishyulalo okadu prabhuvaa, yohaanu thana shishyulaku nerpi nattugaa maakunu praarthanacheya nerpumani aayana nadigenu.
andu kaayanameeru praarthana cheyunappudu thandree, nee naamamu parishuddhaparachabadunu gaaka, nee raajyamu vachunu gaaka,
maaku kaavalasina anudinaahaaramu dinadhinamu maaku dayacheyumu;
memu maakachiyunna prathi vaanini kshaminchuchunnaamu ganuka maapaapamulanu kshaminchumu; mammunu shodhanaloniki thekumu ani palukudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
mariyu aayana vaarithoo itlanenu meelo evanikaina oka snehithudundagaa athadu ardharaatrivela aa snehi thuni yoddhaku vellisnehithudaa, naaku moodurottelu badulimmu;
naa snehithudu prayaanamucheyuchu maargamulo naayoddhaku vachi yunnaadu; athaniki pettutaku naayoddha emiyu ledani athanithoo cheppinayedala
athadu lopalane yundinannu tondharapettavaddu; thalupu vesiyunnadhi, naa chinnapillalu naathookooda pandukoni yunnaaru, nenu lechi iyyalenani cheppunaa?
athadu thana snehithudainanduna lechi iyyakapoyi nanu, athadu siggumaali maati maatiki adugutavalana nainanu lechi athaniki kaavalasinavanniyu ichunu ani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
atuvale meerunu adugudi, mee kiyyabadunu; vedakudi, meeku dorakunu; thattudi, meeku theeyabadunu.
adugu prathivaanikiyyabadunu, vedakuvaaniki dorakunu, thattu vaaniki theeyabadunani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
meelo thandriyainavaadu thana kumaarudu chepanadigithe chepaku prathigaa paamunichunaa? Guddunadigithe thelu nichunaa?
kaabatti meeru cheddavaaraiyundiyu, mee pillalaku manchi yeevulaniyya nerigiyundagaa
paralokamandunna mee thandri thannu aduguvaariki parishuddhaatmanu enthoo nishchaya mugaa anugrahinchunanenu.
okappudaayana moogadayyamunu vellagottu chundenu. aa dayyamu vadalipoyina tharuvaatha moogavaadu maata laadenu ganuka janasamoohamulu aashcharyapadenu.
ayithe vaarilo kondaruveedu dayyamulaku adhipathi yaina bayeljebooluvalana dayyamulanu vellagottuchunnaa dani cheppukoniri.
marikondaru aayananu shodhinchuchuparalokamu nundi yoka soochaka kriyanu choopumani aayana nadigiri.
aayana vaari aalochanala nerigi vaarithoo itlanenu thanaku thaane vyathirekamugaa verupadina prathi raajyamunu paadaipovunu; thanakuthaane virodhamaina yillu koolipovunu.
saathaanunu thanaku vyathireka mugaa thaane verupadina yedala vaani raajyamelaagu niluchunu? Nenu bayeljebooluvalana dayyamulanu vellagottuchunnaanani meeru cheppuchunnaare.
nenu bayeljeboolu valana dayyamulanu vellagottu chunnayedala mee kumaarulu evanivalana vellagottuchunnaaru? Anduchetha vaare meeku theerparulai yunduru.
ayithe nenu dhevuni vrelithoo dayyamulanu vellagottuchunna yedala nishchayamugaa dhevuni raajyamu meeyoddhaku vachiyunnadhi.
balavanthudu aayudhamulu dharinchukoni, thana aavaranamunu kaachukonunappudu, athani sotthu bhadramugaa undunu.
ayithe athanikante balavanthudaina okadu athani paibadi jayinchunappudu, athadu nammukonina aayudhamula nannitini laagukoni athani aasthini panchipettunu.
naa pakshamuna undanivaadu naaku virodhi; naathoo samakoorchanivaadu chedharagottuvaadu.
Apavitraatma yoka manusyuni vadalipoyina tharuvaatha adhi vishraanti vedakuchu neeruleni chootla tiruguchundunu. Vishraanti dorakanandunanenu vidichi vacchina naa yintiki tirigi velludunanukoni
vachi, aa yillu oodchi amarchi yunduta chuchi

velli, thanakante cheddavaina mari yedu (apavitra) aatmalanu ventabettukoni vachunu; avi andulo praveshinchi akkadane kaapuramundunu; andu chetha aa manushyuni kadapati sthithi modatidaanikante chedda dagunani cheppenu.
aayana yee maatalu cheppuchundagaa aa samooha mulo nunna yoka stree aayananu chuchininnu mosina garbhamunu neevu kudichina sthanamulunu dhanyamulainavani kekalu vesi cheppagaa
aayana avunugaani dhevuni vaakyamu vini daanini gaikonuvaaru mari dhanyulani cheppenu.

mariyu janulu gumpulugaa koodinappudu aayana yeelaagu cheppasaagenu'ee tharamuvaaru dushtatharamu vaarai yundi soochaka kriya naduguchu nnaaru. Ayithe yonaanugoorchina soochaka kriyaye gaani mari e soochaka kriyayu veeriki anugrahimpa badadu.
yonaa neeneve pattanasthulaku elaagu soochanagaa undeno aalaage manushya kumaarudunu ee tharamuvaariki soochanagaa undunu.

dakshinadheshapu raani vimarshakaalamuna ee tharamuvaarithoo kooda lechi vaarimeeda nerasthaapanacheyunu. aame solomonu gnaanamu vinutaku bhoomyanthamulanundi vacchenu,idigo solomonukante goppavaadikkada unnaadu.

neeneve manushyulu vimarshakaalamuna ee tharamuvaarithoo kooda niluvabadi vaarimeeda nerasthaapanacheyuduru. Vaaru yonaa prakatana vini maarumanassu pondiri; idigo yonaa kante goppavaadikkada unnaadu.
evadunu deepamu veliginchi, chaatuchootunainanu kunchamukrindhanainanu pettadu gaani, lopaliki vachuvaariki velugu kanabadutaku deepasthambhamumeedane pettunu.
nee dhehamunaku deepamu nee kanne ganuka, nee kannu thetagaa nunte nee dhehamanthayu velugu mayamai yundunu; adhi chedinadaithe nee dhehamunu chikatimayamai yundunu.
kaabatti neelonundu velugu chikatiyaiyundakunda choochu konumu.
e bhaagamainanu chikatikaaka nee dhehamanthayu velugu mayamaithe, deepamu thana kaanthivalana neeku velu gichunappudu elaagunduno aalaagu dhehamanthayu velugumayamai yundunani cheppenu.
aayana maatalaaduchundagaa oka parisayyudu thanathoo kooda bhojanamu cheyumani aayananu piluvagaa aayana lopaliki velli bhojanapankthini koorchundenu.
aayana bhojanamunaku mundhugaa snaanamu cheyaledani aa parisayyudu chuchi aashcharyapadenu.
anduku prabhuvitlanenu parisayyulaina meeru ginneyu pallemunu velupala shuddhi cheyuduru gaani mee antharangamu doputhoonu chedu thanamuthoonu nindiyunnadhi.
avivekulaaraa, velupali bhaagamunu chesinavaadu lopati bhaagamunu cheyaledaa?
kaagaa meeku kaliginavi dharmamu cheyudi, appudu mee kanniyu shuddhigaa undunu.

ayyo parisayyulaaraa, meeru pudeenaa sadaapa modalaina prathi kooralonu padhiyavavanthu chellinchuchunnaare gaani, nyaayamunu dhevuni premanu vidichi pettuchunnaaru. Vaatini maanaka veetini cheyavalasiyunnadhi.
ayyo parisayyulaaraa, meeru samaaja mandiramulalo agrapeethamulanu santhaveedhulalo vandhanamu lanu koruchunnaaru.
ayyo, meeru kanabadani samaadhulavale unnaaru; vaatimeeda naduchu manushyulu (avi samaadhulani) yerugaranenu.
appudu dharmashaastropadheshakudokadu bodhakudaa, yeelaagu cheppi mammunukooda nindinchuchunnaavani aaya nathoo cheppagaa
aayana ayyo, dharma shaastropadheshakulaaraa, moya shakyamukaani baruvulanu meeru manushyulameeda mopuduru gaani meeru oka vrelithoonainanu aa baruvulanu muttaru.
ayyo, mee pitharulu champina pravakthala samaadhulanu meeru kattinchuchunnaaru.
kaavuna meeru saakshulai mee pitharula kaaryamulaku sammathinchu chunnaaru; vaaru pravakthalanu champiri, meeru vaari samaadhulu kattinchuduru.
anduchetha dhevuni gnaanamu cheppina dhemanagaa nenu vaariyoddhaku pravakthalanu aposthalulanu pampudunu.
vaaru kondarini champuduru, kondarini hinsinthuru.

kaabatti lokamu puttinadhi modalukoni, anagaa hebelu rakthamu modalukoni balipeethamunakunu mandiramu nakunu madhyanu nashinchina jekaryaa rakthamuvaraku chindimpabadina pravakthalandari rakthamu nimitthamu ee tharamu vaaru vichaarimpabaduduru; nishchayamugaa ee tharamuvaaru aa rakthamu nimitthamu vichaarimpabadudurani meethoo cheppu chunnaanu.
ayyo, dharmashaastropadheshakulaaraa, meeru gnaanamanu thaalapu chevini etthikoni pothiri; meerunu lopala praveshimparu, praveshinchuvaarini addaginthurani cheppenu.
aayana akkadanundi vellinappudu shaastrulunu parisayyulunu aayana meeda ninda pagabatti aayana meeda neramu mopavalenani yundi,
aayana nota nundi vachu emaatanainanu pattukonutaku ponchi,vedakuchu chaala sangathulanugoorchi aayananu maatalaadimpa saagiri.
anthalo okaninokadu trokkukonunatlu vela koladhi janulu koodinappudu aayana thana shishyulathoo modata itlani cheppasaagenu parisayyula veshadhaarana anu pulisina pindinigoorchi jaagratthapadudi.
marugaina dhediyu bayaluparachabadakapodu; rahasyamainadhediyu teliyabadakapodu.
anduchetha meeru chikatilo maata laadukonunavi velugulo vinabadunu, meeru gadulayandu chevilo cheppukonunadhi middelameeda chaatimpabadunu.
naa snehithulaina meethoo nenu cheppunadhemanagaa dhehamunu champina tharuvaatha maremiyu cheyanerani vaariki bhayapadakudi.
evaniki meeru bhayapadavaleno meeku teliyajeyudunu; champina tharuvaatha narakamulo padadroya shakthigalavaaniki bhayapadudi, aayanake bhaya padudani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
ayidu pichukalu rendu kaasulaku ammabadunu gadaa; ayinanu vaatilo okatainanu dhevuniyeduta maruvabadadu.
mee thalavendruka lanniyu lekkimpabadiyunnavi. Bhayapadakudi; meeru anekamaina pichukalakante shreshthulu kaaraa?
mariyu nenu meethoo cheppunadhemanagaa, nannu manushyulayeduta oppukonuvaadevado, manushyakumaarudu dhevuni doothala yeduta vaanini oppukonunu.
manushyulayeduta nannu erugananuvaanini, nenunu eruganani dhevuni doothalayeduta cheppudunu.
manushyakumaarunimeeda vyathirekamugaa oka maata palukuvaaniki paapakshamaapana kalugunugaani,parishuddhaatmanu dooshinchuvaaniki kshamaapana ledu.
vaaru samaajamandiramula peddalayoddhakunu adhipathulayoddhakunu adhikaarulayoddhakunu mimmunu theesikoni povunappudu meeru'elaagu emi utthara micchedamaa, yemi maatalaadu dumaa ani chinthimpa kudi,
meeremi cheppavalasinadhiyu parishuddhaatma aa gadiyalone meeku nerpunanenu.
aa janasamoohamulo okadubodhakudaa, pitraarjitha mulo naaku paalupanchipettavalenani naa sahodarunithoo cheppumani aayana nadugagaa
aayana oyee, meemeeda theerparinigaanainanu panchipettuvaanigaanainanu nannevadu niyaminchenani athanithoo cheppenu.
mariyu aayana vaarithoomeeru evidhamaina lobhamunaku edamiyyaka jaagratthapadudi; okani kalimi vistharinchuta vaani jeevamunaku moolamu kaadanenu.
mariyu aayana vaarithoo ee upamaanamu cheppenu oka dhanavanthuni bhoomi samruddhigaa pandenu.
appudathadunaa panta samakoorchukonutaku naaku sthalamu chaaladu ganuka nenemi chethunani thanalo thaanaalochinchukoni neneelaagu chethunu;
naa kotlu vippi, vaatikante goppavaatini kattinchi, andulo naa dhaanyamanthatini, naa aasthini samakoorchukoni
naa praanamuthoopraanamaa, aneka samvatsaramulaku,visthaara maina aasthi neeku samakoorchabadiyunnadhi; sukhinchumu, thinumu, traagumu, santhooshinchumani cheppu kondunanu konenu.
ayithe dhevudu verrivaadaa, yee raatri nee praanamu naduguchunnaaru; neevu siddhaparachinavi evani vagunani aathanithoo cheppenu.
dhevuni yedala dhanavanthudu kaaka thanakorake samakoorchukonuvaadu aalaagunane yundunani cheppenu.
anthata aayana thana shishyulathoo itlanenu–ee hethuvuchetha meeru – emi thindumo, ani mee praanamunugoorchiyainanu, emi dharinchukondumo, ani mee dhehamunugoorchiyainanu chinthimpakudi.
aahaaramukante praanamunu vastramukante dhehamunu goppavi kaavaa?
kaakula sangathi vichaarinchi choodudi. Avi vitthavu, koyavu, vaatiki gariseledu, kottuledu; ayinanu dhevudu vaatini poshinchuchunnaadu; meeru pakshulakante enthoo shreshthulu.
mariyu meelo evadu chinthichutavalana thana yetthunu mooredekkuva chesikona galadu?
kaabatti annitikante thakkuvainavi meechetha kaakapothe thakkina vaatini goorchi meeru chinthimpanela? Puvvulelaagu eduguchunnavo aalochinchudi.
avi kashtapadavu, vadukavu; ayinanu thana samasthavaibhavamuthoo koodina solomonu sayithamu veetilo okadaanivalenaina alankarimpabadaledani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
nedu polamulo undi, repu poyiloveyabadu adavi gaddini dhevudeelaagu alankarinchinayedala, alpa vishvaasulaaraa, meeku mari enthoo nishchayamugaa vastramulanichunu.
emi thindumo, yemi traagudumo, ani vichaarimpakudi, anumaanamu kaligiyundakudi.
ee lokapu janulu veetinannitini vedakuduru; ivi meeku kaavalasiyunnavani mee thandriki teliyunu.
meeraithe aayana raajyamunu vedakudi, daanithoo kooda ivi mee kanugrahimpabadunu.
chinna mandaa bhayapadakudi, meeku raajyamu anugrahinchutaku mee thandriki ishtamaiyunnadhi
meeku kaliginavaatini ammi dharmamu cheyudi, paathagilani sanchulanu paralokamandu akshayamaina dhanamunu sampaadhinchukonudi; akkadiki dongaraadu, chimmetakottadu
mee dhanamekkada unduno akkadane mee hrudayamu undunu.
mee nadumulu kattukoniyundudi, mee deepamulu veluguchundaniyyudi.
thama prabhuvu pendlivindunundi vachi thattagaane athaniki thaluputheeyutaku athadeppudu vachuno ani athanikoraku eduru choochu manushyulavale undudi.

prabhuvu vachi ye daasulu melakuvagaa unduta kanugonuno aa daasulu dhanyulu; athadu nadumu kattukoni vaarini bhojana pankthini koorchundabetti, thaane vachi vaariki upachaaramu cheyunani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
mariyu athadu rendava jaamuna vachinanu moodava jaamuna vachinanu (e daasulu) melakuvagaa unduta kanugonuno aa daasulu dhanyulu.
dongaye gadiyanu vachuno yinti yajamaanuniki telisinayedala athadu melakuvagaa undi, thana yintiki kannamu veyaniyyadani telisikonudi.
meeru anukonani gadiyalo manushyakumaarudu vachunu ganuka meerunu siddhamugaa undudani cheppenu.
appudu pethuru prabhuvaa, yee upamaanamu maathoone cheppuchunnaavaa andarithoonu cheppuchu nnaavaa? Ani aayana nadugagaa
prabhuvu itlanenu thagina kaalamuna prathivaaniki aahaaramu pettutaku, yajamaanudu thana yintivaarimeeda niyaminchunatti nammakamaina buddhigala gruhanirvaahakudevadu?
evani prabhuvu vachi, vaadu aalaagu cheyuchunduta kanugonuno aa daasudu dhanyudu.
athadu thanaku kaliginadaani yanthatimeeda vaani unchunani meethoo nijamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
ayithe aa daasudu naa yajamaanudu vachuta kaalasyamu cheyuchunnaadani thana manassulo anukoni, daasulanu daaseelanukotti, thini traagimatthugaa undasaagithe
vaadu kanipettani dinamulonu erugani gadiyalonu aa daasuni yajamaanudu vachi vaani narikinchi, apanammakasthulathoo vaaniki paalu niyaminchunu.
thana yajamaanuni chittha merigi yundiyu siddhapadaka, athani chitthamuchoppuna jarigimpaka undu daasuniki anekamaina debbalu thagulunu.
