ayithe teliyaka debbalaku thagina panulu chesinavaaniki koddi debbale thagulunu. Evaniki ekkuvagaa iyya badeno vaaniyoddha ekkuvagaa theeyajoothuru; manushyulu evaniki ekkuvagaa appaginthuro vaani yoddha ekkuvagaa aduguduru.
nenu bhoomimeeda agniveya vachithini; adhi idivarake ragulukoni mandavalenani yenthoo koruchunnaanu.
ayithe nenu pondavalasina baapthismamunnadhi, adhi neraveru varaku nenenthoo ibbandipaduchunnaanu.
nenu bhoomi meeda samaadhaanamu kalugajeya vachi thinani meeru thalanchu chunnaaraa? Kaadu; bhedamune kaluga jeyavachithinani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
ipputinundi oka intilo ayiduguru verupadi, iddariki virodha mugaa muggurunu, mugguriki virodhamugaa yiddarunu unduru.
thandri kumaarunikini, kumaarudu thandrikini, thalli kumaarthekunu, kumaarthe thallikini, attha kodalikini, kodalu atthakunu virodhulugaa undurani cheppenu.
mariyu aayana janasamoohamulathoo itlanenu meeru padamatanundi mabbu paiki vachuta choochu nappudu vaanavachuchunnadani ventane cheppuduru; aalaage jarugunu.
dakshinapu gaali visaruta choochunappudu vadagaali kottunani cheppuduru; aalaage jarugunu.
veshadhaarulaaraa, meeru bhoomyaakaashamula vaikhari gurthimpa neruguduru; ee kaalamunu meeru gurthimpa nerugarela?
edi nyaayamo mee anthata meeru vimarshimparela?

vaadhinchuvaanithoo kooda adhikaariyoddhaku neevu velluchundagaa athani chethinundi thappinchukonutaku trovalone prayatnamu cheyumu,ledaa, athadokavela ninnu nyaayaadhipathiyoddhaku eedchukoni povunu, nyaayaadhipathi ninnu bantrauthunaku appaginchunu, bantrauthu ninnu cherasaalalo veyunu.
neevu kadapati kaasu chellinchuvaraku velupaliki raane raavani neethoo cheppuchunnaananenu.
pilaathu galilayulaina kondari rakthamu vaari balulathoo kalipiyundenu. aa kaalamuna akkadanunna kondaru aa sangathi yesuthoo cheppagaa
aayana vaarithoo itlanenu ee galilayulu atti hinsalu pondinanduna vaaru galilayulandarikante paapulani meeru thalanchu chunnaaraa?
kaarani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu; meeru maarumanassu pondaniyedala meerandarunu aalaage nashinthuru.
mariyu siloyamuloni gopuramu padi chachina aa padunenimidimandi, yerooshalemulo kaapuramunna vaarandarikante aparaadhulani thalanchuchunnaaraa?
kaarani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu; meeru maarumanassu pondaniyedala meerandarunu aalaage nashinthuru.
mariyu aayana vaarithoo ee upamaanamu cheppenu oka manushyuni draakshathootalo anjoorapu chettokati naatabadi yundenu. Athadu daani pandlu vedaka vachinappudu emiyu dorakaledu

ganuka athadu idigo moodendlanundi nenu ee anjoorapu chettuna pandlu vedakavachuchunnaanu gaani yemiyu dorakaledu; deenini narikiveyumu, deenivalana ee bhoomiyu ela vyarthamai povalenani draakshathoota maalithoo cheppenu.
ayithe vaadu ayyaa, nenu daanichuttu travvi, yeruvu veyumattuku ee samvatsaramukooda undanimmu;
adhi phalinchina sari, leniyedala narikinchiveyumani athanithoo cheppenu.
vishraanthi dinamuna aayana yoka samaajamandiramulo bodhinchuchunnappudu
padunenimidi endlanundi balaheena parachu dayyamu pattina yoka stree acchata nundenu. aame nadumu vangipoyi yentha maatramunu chakkagaa niluvabadalekundenu.
yesu aamenu chuchi, rammani pilichi ammaa, nee balaheenathanundi vidudala pondi yunnaavani aamethoo cheppi
aame meeda chethulunchagaane aame chakkagaa niluvabadi dhevuni mahimaparachenu.

yesu vishraanthidinamuna svasthaparachinanduna aa samaaja mandirapu adhikaari kopamuthoo mandipadi, janasamooha munu chuchipanicheyadagina aaru dinamulu kalavu ganuka aa dinamulalone vachi svasthathapondudi; vishraanthidinamandu raavaddani cheppenu.
anduku prabhuvu veshadhaarulaaraa, meelo prathivaadunu vishraanthidinamuna thana yeddunainanu gaadidhanainanu gaadiyoddhanundi vippi, thoolu konipoyi, neellu pettunu gadaa.
idigo padunenimidi endlanundi saathaanu bandhinchina abraahaamu kumaartheyaina yeemenu vishraanthidinamandu ee katlanundi vidipimpadagadaa? Ani athanithoo cheppenu.
aayana ee maatalu cheppinappudu aayana nedirinchina vaarandaru siggupadiri; ayithe janasamoohamanthayu aayana chesina ghana kaaryamulannitini chuchi santhooshinchenu.
aayanadhevuni raajyamu dhenini poliyunnadhi? dhenithoo daani polthunu?
oka manushyudu theesikonipoyi thana thootalovesina aavaginjanu poliyunnadhi. adhi perigi vrukshamaayenu; aakaashapakshulu daani kommala yandu nivasinchenanenu.
marala aayanadhevuni raajyamunu dhenithoo polthunu?
oka stree theesikoni, anthayu pulisi ponguvaraku moodu kunchamula pindilo daachi pettina pullani pindini poliyunnadani cheppenu.
aayana yerooshalemunaku prayaanamai povuchu bodhinchuchu pattanamulalonu graamamulalonu sanchaaramu cheyuchundenu.
okadu prabhuvaa, rakshanapondu vaaru koddimandhenaa? Ani aayana nadugagaa
aayana vaarini chuchi iruku dvaaramuna praveshimpa poraadudi; anekulu praveshimpa joothuru gaani vaarivalana kaadani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
inti yajamaanudu lechi thalupuvesina tharuvaatha meeru velupala nilichi thalupu thatti ayyaa, maaku thalupu theeyumani cheppa naarambhinchi nappudu
aayana mee rekkadivaaro mimmunu eruganani uttharamu meethoo cheppunu. Anduku meerunee samukha mandu memu thini traaguchuntime; neevu maa veedhulalo bodhinchithive ani cheppa saaguduru.
appudaayana mee rekkadivaaro mimmunu eruganani meethoo cheppu chunnaanu; akramamu cheyu meerandaru naa yoddhanundi tolagipondani cheppunu.
abraahaamu issaaku yaakobulunu sakala pravakthalunu dhevuni raajyamulo undutayu, meeru velupaliki troyabadutayu, meeru choochunappudu meeru edchuchu pandlu korukuduru.
mariyu janulu thoorpunundiyu padamata nundiyu uttharamunundiyu dakshinamunundiyuvachi, dhevuni raajyamandu koorchunduru.
idigo kadapati vaarilo kondaru modati vaaraguduru, modativaarilo kondaru kadapati vaaragudurani cheppenu.
aa gadiyalone kondaru parisayyulu vachinee vikkadanundi bayaludheri pommu; herodu ninnu champa goruchunnaadani aayanathoo cheppagaa
aayana vaarini chuchimeeru velli, aa nakkathoo eelaagu cheppudi idigo nedunu repunu nenu dayyamulanu vella gottuchu (rogulanu) svasthaparachuchunundi moodava dinamuna poorna siddhi pondedanu.
ayinanu nedu repu ellundi naa trovanu nenu povuchundavalenu; pravaktha yerooshalemu naku velupala nashimpa vallapadadu.

yerooshalemaa, yerooshalemaa, pravakthalanu champuchu, neeyoddhaku pampa badinavaarini raallathoo kottuchu undudaanaa, kodi thana pillalanu thana rekkala krinda elaagu cherchukonuno aalaage enno maarulu nenu nee plilalanu cherchukonavalenani yuntinigaani mee rollakapothiri.
idigo mee yillu meeku paadugaa viduvabaduchunnadhi prabhuvu perata vachuvaadu sthuthimpabadunugaakani meeru cheppuvaraku meeru nannu choodarani meethoo cheppuchunnaananenu.
vishraanthidinamuna aayana bhojanamu cheyutaku parisayyula adhikaarulalo okani yintiloniki vellinappudu, aayana emi cheyuno ani vaaraayananu kanipettu chundiri.
appudu jalodhara rogamugala yokadu aayana yeduta undenu.
yesu vishraanthidinamuna svasthaparachuta nyaayamaa kaadaa?
ani dharmashaastropadhesha kulanu parisayyulanu adugagaa vaaroorakundiri. Appu daayana vaanini cheradeesi svasthaparachi pampivesi
meelo evani gaadidayainanu eddayinanu guntalo padinayedala vishraanthidinamuna daanini paiki theeyadaa? Ani vaari nadi genu.
ee maatalaku vaaru uttharamu cheppalekapoyiri.
piluvabadinavaaru bhojanapankthini agrapeethamulu erparachu konuta chuchi aayana vaarithoo ee upamaanamu cheppenu.
ninnevarainanu pendlivinduku pilichinappudu agrapeethamu meeda koorchundavaddhu; okavela neekante ghanudu athani chetha piluvabadagaa
ninnunu athanini pilichinavaadu vachi ithaniki chootimmani neethoo cheppunu, appudu neevu siggu padi kadapati chootuna koorchundasaaguduvu.
ayithe neevu piluvabadi nappudu, ninnu pilichinavaadu vachisnehi thudaa, paichootiki pommani neethoo cheppulaaguna neevu poyi kadapati chootuna koorchundumu; appudu neethookooda koorchundu
thannu thaanu hechinchukonu prathivaadunu thaggimpabadunu; thannuthaanu thagginchukonuvaadu hechimpabadunani cheppenu.

mariyu aayana thannu pilichinavaanithoo itlanenu neevu pagati vindainanu raatri vindainanu cheyunappudu, nee snehithulanainanu nee sahodarulanainanu nee bandhuvula nainanu dhanavanthulagu nee poruguvaarinainanu piluvavaddu; vaaru okavela ninnu marala piluthuru ganuka neeku pratyupa kaaramu kalugunu.
ayithe neevu vindu cheyunappudu beedalanu angaheenulanu kuntivaandranu gruddivaandranu piluvumu.
neeku pratyupakaaramu cheyutaku vaari kemiyu ledu ganuka neevu dhanyudavaguduvu; neethimanthula punarut'thaanamandu neevu pratyupakaaramu ponduduvani cheppenu.
aayanathoo kooda bhojanapankthini koorchundinavaarilo okadu ee maatalu vinidhevuni raajyamulo bhojanamu cheyuvaadu dhanyudani aayanathoo cheppagaa
aayana athanithoo nitlanenu oka manushyudu goppa vindu cheyinchi anekulanu pilichenu.
vindukaalamandu athadu ippudu siddhamaiyunnadhi, randani piluvabadinavaarithoo chepputaku thana daasuni pampenu.
ayithe vaarandaru ekamanassuthoo nepamulu cheppa saagiri. Modativaadu nenoka polamu koniyunnaanu, avashyamugaa vellidaani choodavalenu, nannu kshamimpavalenani ninnu vedu konuchunnaana
mariyekadu nenu ayidu jathala yedlanu koniyunnaanu, vaatini pareekshimpa velluchunnaanu, nannu kshamimpavalenani vedukonuchunnaananenu.
mari yokadunenoka streeni vivaahamu chesikonnaanu; anduchetha nenu raalenanenu.

appudaa daasudu thirigi vachi yee maatalu thana yajamaanuniki teliyajeyagaa, aa yinti yaja maanudu kopapadineevu tvaragaapattanapu veedhulalonikini sandulalonikini velli, beedalanu angaheenulanu kuntivaarini gruddivaarini ikkadiki thodukonirammani aa daasunitho cheppenu
anthata daasudu prabhuvaa,nee vaagnaapinchinattu chesithinigaani yinkanu chootunnadani cheppenu.
anduku yajamaanudu-naa yillu nindu natlu neevu raajamaargamulalonikini kanchelalonikini velli lopaliki vachutaku akkadivaarini balavanthamu cheyumu;
yelayanagaa piluvabadina aa manushyulalo okadunu naa vindu ruchichoodadani meethoo cheppuchunnaananenu.
bahu janasamoohamulu aayanathoo kooda vellu chunnappudu aayana vaarithattu thirigi
evadainanu naa yoddhaku vachi thana thandrini thallini bhaaryanu pillalanu anna dammulanu akkachellendranu thana praanamunu sahaa dveshimpakunte vaadu naa shishyudu kaaneradu.
mariyu evadainanu thana siluvanu mosikoni nannu vembadimpani yedala vaadu naa shishyudu kaaneradu.
meelo evadainanu oka gopuramu kattimpa gorina yedala daanini konasaaginchutaku kaavalasinadhi thana yoddha unnado ledo ani koorchundi thagulubadi modata lekkachoochukonadaa?
choochukonaniyedala athadu daani punaadhivesi, okavela daanini konasaagimpa leka poyinanduna
choochuvaarandaru ee manushyudu katta modalupettenu gaani kona saagimpaleka poyenani athani chuchi yegathaali cheya saaguduru.

mariyu e raajainanu mariyoka raajuthoo yuddhamu cheyabovunappudu thanameediki iruvadhivela mandithoo vachuvaanini padhivelamandithoo edirimpa shakthi thanaku kalado ledo ani koorchundi modata aalochimpadaa?
shakthi leniyedala athadinkanu dooramugaa unnappude raayabaaramu pampi samaadhaanamu chesikona choochunu gadaa.
aa prakaarame meelo thanaku kaligina danthayu vidichi pettanivaadu naa shishyudu kaaneradu.
uppu manchidhegaani uppu nissaaramaithe dhenivalana daaniki saaramu kalugunu?
adhi bhoomikainanu eruvukainanu panikiraadu ganuka daanini bayata paaraveyuduru. Vinutaku chevulugalavaadu vinunugaaka ani vaarithoo cheppenu.
okappudu samasthamaina sunkarulunu paapulunu aayana bodha vinutaku aayana daggaraku vachuchundagaa
parisayyulunu shaastrulunu adhi chuchi'ithadu paapulanu cherchukoni vaarithoo kooda bhojanamu cheyuchunnaadani chaala sanugukoniri.
andukaayana vaarithoo ee upamaanamu cheppenu
meelo e manushyunikainanu nooru gorrelu kaligi yundagaa vaatilo okati thappipoyinayedala athadu tombadhi tommidintini adavilo vidichipetti, thappipoyi nadhi dorakuvaraku daanini vedaka velladaa?
adhi dorakinappudu santhooshamuthoo daanini thana bhujamulameeda vesi koni yintiki vachi thana snehithulanu poruguvaarini pilichi
meeru naathookooda santhooshinchudi; thappipoyina naa gorra dorakinadani vaarithoo cheppunu gadaa.
atuvale maarumanassu akkaraleni tombadhi tommidimandi neethimanthula vishayamai kalugu santhooshamukante maarumanassu pondu okka paapi vishayamai paraloka mandu ekkuva santhooshamu kalugunu.
e streekainanu padhi vendi naanamulundagaa vaatilo oka naanamu pogottukonte aame deepamu veliginchi yillu oodchi adhi dorakuvaraku jaagratthagaa vedakadaa?
adhi dorakinappudu thana chelikattelanu poruguvaarini pilichi naathoo kooda santhooshinchudi, nenu pogottukonina naanamu dorakinadani vaarithoo cheppunu gadaa.
atuvale maarumanassu pondu oka paapi vishayamai dhevuni doothalayeduta santhooshamu kalugunani meethoo cheppu chunnaananenu.
mariyu aayana itlanenu oka manushyuniki iddaru kumaarulundiri.
vaarilo chinnavaadu thandree, aasthilo naakuvachu bhaagamimmani thana thandri nadu gagaa, athadu vaariki thana aasthini panchipettenu.
konnidinamulaina tharuvaatha aa chinna kumaarudu samasthamunu koorchukoni doora dheshamunaku prayaanamai poyi, acchata thana aasthini durvyaapaaramuvalana paaduchesenu.
adanthayu kharchu chesina tharuvaatha aa dheshamandu goppa karavu raagaa vaadu ibbandi pada saagi,
velli aa dheshasthulalo okanichentha jerenu. Athadu pandulanu meputaku thana polamulaloniki vaanini pampenu.
vaadu pandulu thinu pottuthoo thana kadupu nimpukona ashapadenu gaani yevadunu vaani kemiyu iyyaledu.
ayithe buddhi vachinappudu vaadu naa thandriyoddha enthoomandi koolivaandraku annamu samruddhigaa unnadhi, nenaithe ikkada aakaliki chachipovu chunnaanu.
nenu lechi naa thandriyoddhaku velli -thandree, nenu paralokamunaku virodhamugaanu nee yedutanu paapamu chesithini;
ikameedata nee kumaarudanani ani pinchukonutaku yogyudanu kaanu; nannu nee kooli vaarilo okanigaa pettukonumani athanithoo cheppudunanukoni, lechi thandriyoddhaku vacchenu.
vaadinka dooramugaa unnappudu thandri vaanini chuchi kanikarapadi, parugetthi vaani medameedapadi muddupettukonenu.
appudu aa kumaarudu athanithoo thandree, nenu paraloka munaku virodhamugaanu nee yedutanu paapamu chesithini; ikameedata nee kumaarudanani anipinchukonutaku yogyudanu kaananenu.
ayithe thandri thana daasulanu chuchi prashastha vastramu tvaragaa techi veenikikatti, veeni chethiki ungaramu petti, paadamulaku cheppulu todiginchudi;
krovvina doodanu techi vadhinchudi, manamu thini santhooshapadudamu;
ee naa kumaarudu chanipoyimarala bradhikenu, thappipoyi dorakenani cheppenu; anthata vaaru santhooshapadasaagiri.
appudu athani pedda kumaarudu polamulo undenu. Vaadu (polamunundi) vachuchu intidaggaraku raagaa, vaadyamulunu naatyamunu jaruguta vini
daasulalo okani pilichi ivi emitani adugagaa
aa daasudu athanithoo nee thammudu vachi yunnaadu, athadu thana yoddhaku surakshithamugaa vachi nanduna nee thandri krovvina doodanu vadhinchenanenu.
ayithe athadu kopapadi lopaliki vellanollaka poyenu ganuka athani thandri velupaliki vachi (lopaliki rammani) bathimaalukonenu.

andukathadu thana thandrithoo idigo yinniyendlanundi ninnu sevinchuchunnaane, nee aagnanu nenennadunu meeraledhe; ayinanu naa snehithulathoo santhooshapadunatlu neevu naakennadunu oka mekapillanaina iyyaledu.
ayithe nee aasthini veshyalathoo thini vesina yee nee kumaarudu raagaane veenikoraku krovvina doodanu vadhinchithivani cheppenu.
andukathadu kumaarudaa, nee vellappudunu naathookooda unnaavu; naavanniyu neevi,
manamu santhooshapadi aanandinchuta yukthame; ee nee thammudu chanipoyi thirigi bradhikenu, thappipoyi dorakenani athanithoo cheppenu.
mariyu aayana thana shishyulathoo itlanenu oka dhanavanthuniyoddha oka gruhanirvaahakudundenu. Vaadathani aasthini paaducheyuchunnaadani athaniyoddha vaani meeda neramu mopabadagaa
athadu vaani pilipinchi ninnugoorchi nenu vinuchunna yee maata emiti? nee gruhanirvaahakatvapu lekka appaginchumu; neevu ika meedata gruhanirvaahakudavai yunda vallakaadani vaanithoo cheppenu.
aa gruhanirvaahakudu thanalo thaanu naa yajamaanudu ee gruhanirvaaha katvapu panilonundi nannu theesiveyunu ganuka nenu emi chethunu? Travvalenu, bhikshamettha siggupaduchunnaanu.
nannu ee gruhanirvaahakatvapu paninundi tolaginchunappudu vaaru nannu thama yindlaloniki cherchukonunatlu emi cheyavaleno naaku teliyunanukoni,
thana yajamaanuni runasthulalo okkokkani pilipinchi neevu naa yajamaanuniki entha achiyunnaavani modativaani nadigenu.
vaadu nooru manugula noone ani cheppagaa neevu nee chiti theesi koni tvaragaa koorchundi yebadhi manugulani vraasi kommani vaanithoo cheppenu.
tharuvaatha vaadu neevu entha achiyunnaavani mariyokani nadugagaa vaadu nooru thoomula godhumalani cheppinappudu. Vaanithooneevu nee chiti theesikoni yenubadhi thoomulani vraasikommani cheppenu.
anyaayasthudaina aa gruhanirvaahakudu yukthigaa naduchukonenani vaani yajamaanudu vaani mechukonenu. Velugu sambandhulakante ee loka sambandhulu thama tharamunubatti choodagaa yukthiparulai yunnaru.
anyaayapu sirivalana meeku snehithulanu sampaadhinchukonudi; endukanagaa aa siri mimmunu vadhili povunappudu vaaru nityamaina nivaasamulalo mimmunu cherchukondurani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
mikkili konchemulo nammakamugaa unduvaadu ekkuvalonu nammakamugaa undunu; mikkili konchemulo anyaayamugaa unduvaadu ekkuvalonu anyaayamugaa undunu.
kaabatti meeru anyaayapu siri vishayamulo nammakamugaa undaniyedala satyamaina dhanamunu evaru mee vashamu cheyunu?
meeru parula sommu visha yamulo nammakamugaa undaniyedala mee sonthamainadhi meeku evadichunu?
e sevakudunu iddaru yajamaanulanu sevimpaledu; vaadu okani dveshinchi okani premiṁ chunu, leka okani anusarinchi okani truneekarinchunu; meeru dhevunini sirini sevimpa lerani cheppenu.
dhanaapekshagala parisayyulu ee maatalanniyu vini aayananu apahasinchuchundagaa
aayana meeru manushyulayeduta neethimanthulani anipinchukonuvaaru gaani dhevudu mee hrudayamulanu erugunu. Manushyulalo ghanamugaa enchabadunadhi dhevuni drushtiki asahyamu.
yohaanu kaalamuvaraku dharmashaastra munu pravakthalunu undiri; appatinundi dhevuni raajya suvaartha prakatimpa baduchunnadhi; prathivaadunu aa raajyamulo balavanthamugaa jorabaduchunnaadu
dharmashaastramulo oka pollayina thappi povutakante aakaashamunu bhoomiyu gathinchipovuta sulabhamu.
thana bhaaryanu vidanaadi, mariyokatenu vivaahamu chesikonu prathivaadu vyabhicha rinchuchunnaadu; bharthanu vidichinadaanini vivaahamu chesi konuvaadu vyabhicharinchuchunnaadu.
dhanavanthudokadundenu. Athadu oodaarangu battalunu sannapu naara vastramulunu dharinchukoni prathi dinamu bahugaa sukhapaduchunduvaadu.
laajaru anu oka daridrudundenu. Vaadu kurupulathoo nindinavaadai dhanavanthuni yinti vaakita padiyundi
athani ballameeda nundi padu rottemukkalathoo aakali theerchukona gorenu; anthekaaka kukkalu vachi vaani kurupulu naakenu.
aa daridrudu chanipoyi dhevadoothalachetha abraahaamu rommuna (aanukonutaku) konipobadenu. Dhanavanthudu kooda chanipoyi paathipettabadenu.
appudathadu paathaalamulo baadhapaduchu, kannuletthi dooramunundi abraa haamunu athani rommuna (aanukoniyunna) laajarunu chuchi
thandrivaina abraahaamaa, naayandu kanikarapadi, thana vrelikonanu-neellalomunchi naa naalukanu challaarchutaku laajarunu pampumu; nenu ee agnijvaalalo yaathanapaduchunnaanani kekaluvesi cheppenu.

anduku abraahaamu-kumaarudaa, neevu nee jeevithakaalamandu neekishtamainattu sukhamu anubhavinchithivi, aalaagunane laajaru kashtamu anubhavinchenani gnaapakamu chesikonumu; ippudaithe vaadu ikkada nemmadhi ponduchunnaadu, neevu yaathana paduchunnaavu.
anthekaaka ikkadanundi mee yoddhaku daata goruvaaru daati pojaalakundunatlunu, akkadi vaaru maayoddhaku daati raajaalakundunatlunu, maakunu meekunu madhya mahaa agaadhamunchabadiyunnadani cheppenu.
appudathadu thandree, aalaagaithe naa kayiduguru sahodarulunnaaru.
vaarunu ee vedhanakaramaina sthalamunaku raakunda vaariki saakshyamichutakai naa thandri yintiki vaani pampavalenani ninnu vedukonuchunnaananenu.
anduku abraahaamu -vaariyoddha mosheyu pravakthalunu unnaaru; vaari maatalu vinavalenani athanithoo cheppagaa
athadu thandrivaina abraahaamaa, aalaagu anavaddu; mruthulalonundi okadu vaariyoddhaku vellina yedala vaaru maarumanassu pondudurani cheppenu.
andukathadu mosheyu pravakthalunu (cheppina maatalu) vaaru vinaniyedala mruthulalo nundi okadu lechinanu vaaru nammarani athanithoo cheppenanenu.
aayana thana shishyulathoo itlanenu abhyantharamulu raakapovuta asaadhyamukaani avi evanivalana vachuno vaaniki shrama.
vaadee chinnavaarilo okaniki abhyantharamu kalugajeyutakante vaani medaku thiru gatiraayi kattabadi samudramulo padadroyabaduta vaaniki melu.
mee vishayamai meere jaagratthagaa undudi. nee sahodarudu thappidamu chesinayedala athani gaddinchumu; athadu maarumanassu pondina yedala athani kshaminchumu.
athadu oka dinamuna edumaarulu neeyedala thappidamu chesi yedu maarulu neevaiputhirigimaarumanassu pondithi naninayedala athani kshamimpavalenanenu.
aposthalulumaa vishvaasamu vruddhipondinchumani prabhuvuthoo cheppagaa
prabhuvu meeru aavaginjantha vishvaasamu galavaaraithe ee kambalichettunu chuchineevu vellathookooda pellagimpabadi samudramulo naatabadumani cheppunappudu adhi meeku lobadunu.
dunnuvaadu gaani mepuvaadu gaani meelo evanikaina oka daasudundagaa, vaadu polamulonundi vachi nappuduneevu ippade velli bhojanamu cheyumani vaanithoo cheppunaa? cheppadu.

anthekaakanenu bhojanamu cheyutaku emainanu siddha parachi, nadumu kattukoni nenu annapaanamulu puchu konuvaraku naaku parichaaramu cheyumu; atutharuvaatha neevu annapaanamulu puchukonavachunani vaanithoo cheppunu gaani
aa daasudu aagnaapimpabadina panulu chesinanduku vaadu dayachoopenani vaanini mechunaa?
atuvale meerunu meeku aagnaapimpabadinavanniyu chesina tharuvaathamemu nish‌prayojakulamaina daasulamu,memu cheyavalasinave chesiyunnaamani cheppudanenu.
aayana yerooshalemunaku prayaanamai povuchu samaraya galilayala madhyagaa velluchundenu.
aayana yoka graamamuloniki velluchundagaa padhi mandi kushtha rogulu aayanaku edurugaa vachi dooramuna nilichi
yesu prabhuvaa, mammu karuninchumani kekalu vesiri.
aayana vaarini chuchimeeru velli, mimmunu yaajakulaku kanuparachukonudani vaarithoo cheppenu. Vaaru velluchundagaa, shuddhulairi.
vaarilo okadu thanaku svasthatha kaluguta chuchi
goppa shabdamuthoo dhevuni mahimaparachuchu, thirigi vachi aayanaku kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchuchu, aayana paadamulayoddha saagilapadenu; vaadu samarayudu.
anduku yesupadhimandi shuddhulairi kaaraa; aa tommanduguru ekkada?
ee anyudu thappa dhevuni mahimaparachutaku thirigi vachinavaadevadunu agapadaledaa ani cheppi
neevu lechipommu, nee vishvaa samu ninnu svasthaparachenani vaanithoo cheppenu.
dhevuni raajyameppudu vachunani parisayyulu aayana nadiginappudu aayanadhevuni raajyamu pratyakshamugaa raadu.
endukanagaa idigo dhevuni raajyamu mee madhyane yunnadhi ganuka, idigo yikkadanani, adhigo akkadanani cheppa veelupadadani vaariki uttharamicchenu.
mariyu aayana thana shishyulathoo itlanenu manushya kumaaruni dinamulalo okadhinamu choodavalenani meeru koru dinamulu vachunugaani meeru aa dinamunu choodaru.
vaaru'idigo yikkadanani adhigo akkadanani meethoo cheppinayedala vellakudi, vembadimpakudi.
aakaashamu krinda oka dikkunundi merupumerisi, aakaashamukrinda mariyoka dikkuna kelaagu prakaashinchuno aalaaguna manushyakumaarudu thana dinamuna undunu.
ayithe mundhugaa aayana aneka hinsalu pondi yee tharamu vaarichetha upekshimpabadavalenu.
novahu dinamulalo jariginattu manushyakumaaruni dinamulalonu jarugunu.
novahu odaloniki vellina dinamuvaraku janulu thinuchu traaguchu pendlaaduchu pendli kiyyabaduchu nundiri; anthalo jalapralayamu vachi vaarinandarini naashanamuchesenu.
lothu dinamulalo jarigi nattunu jarugunu. Janulu thinuchu traaguchu konuchu ammuchu naaru naatuchu indlu kattuchu nundiri.
ayithe lothu sodoma vidichipoyina dinamuna aakaashamu nundi agni gandhakamulu kurisi vaarinandarini naashanamu chesenu.
aa prakaarame manushyakumaarudu pratyakshamagu dinamuna jarugunu.
aa dinamuna middemeeda undu vaadu inta undu thana saamagrini theesikonipovutaku diga koodadu; aalaage polamulo unduvaadunu thirigi raakoodadu.
lothu bhaaryanu gnaapakamu chesikonudi.
thana praanamunu rakshinchukonagoruvaadu daanini pogottukonunu, daani pogottukonuvaadu daanini sajeevamugaa kaapaadukonunu.
aa raatri yiddarokka manchamumeeda unduru; vaarilo okaru konipobadunu okaru vidichipettabadunu.
iddaru streelu okka thirugali visaruchunduru; okate konipobadunu okate vidichipetta badunanenu.
shishyulu prabhuvaa, yidi ekkada (jarugu) nani aayana nadiginanduku
aayana peenugu ekkada unnado akkada gaddalunu pogavunani vaarithoo cheppenu.
vaaru visukaka nityamu praarthana cheyuchundavale nanutaku aayana vaarithoo ee upamaanamu cheppenu.
dhevuniki bhayapadakayu manushyulanu lakshya pettakayu nundu oka nyaayaadhipathi yoka pattana mulo undenu.
aa pattanamulo oka vidhavaraalunu undenu. aame athaniyoddhaku tharachugaavachi naa prathivaadhikini naakunu nyaayamu theerchumani aduguchu vacchenu gaani
athadu konthakaalamu oppakapoyenu. tharuvaatha athadu-nenu dhevuniki bhayapadakayu manushyulanu lakshyapettakayu undinanu
ee vidhavaraalu nannu tondharapettuchunnadhi ganuka aame maati maatiki vachi gojaadakundunatlu aameku nyaayamu theerthunani thanalothaananukonenu.
mariyu prabhuvitlanenu anyaayasthudaina aa nyaayaadhi pathi cheppina maata vinudi.
dhevudu thaanu erparachukonina vaaru divaaraatrulu thannugoorchi morrapettukonu chundagaa vaariki nyaayamu theerchadaa?

aayana vaariki tvaragaa nyaayamu theerchunu; vaarinishayame gadaa aayana deerghashaanthamu choopuchunnaadani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu. Ayinanu manushya kumaarudu vachunappudu aayana bhoomi meeda vishvaasamu kanugonunaa?
thaame neethimanthulani thammu nammukoni yitharulanu truneekarinchu kondarithoo aayana ee upamaanamu cheppenu.
praarthanacheyutakai yiddaru manushyulu dhevaalayamunaku velliri. Vaarilo okadu parisayyudu, okadu sunkari.
parisayyudu niluvabadidhevaa, nenu choorulunu anyaayasthulunu vyabhichaarulunaina yithara manushyulavalenainanu, ee sunkarivalenainanu undananduku neeku kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchuchunnaanu.
vaaramunaku rendu maarulu upa vaasamu cheyuchu naa sampaadhana anthatilo padhiyava vanthu chellinchuchunnaanani thanalothaanu praarthinchuchundenu.
ayithe sunkari dooramugaa niluchundi, aakaashamuvaipu kannu letthutakainanu dhairyamuchaalaka rommu kottukonuchudhevaa, paapinaina nannu karuninchumani palikenu.

athanikante ithadu neethimanthudugaa theerchabadi thana yintiki vellenani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu. thannu thaanu hechinchukonuvaadu thaggimpabadunaniyu thannu thaanu thagginchukonuvaadu hechimpabadunaniyu cheppenu.
thama shishuvulanu muttavalenani kondaru aayanayoddhaku vaarini theesikoniraagaa aayana shishyulu adhi chuchi theesi konivachina vaarini gaddinchiri.
ayithe yesu vaarini thanayoddhaku pilichichinna biddalanu aatankaparachaka vaarini naayoddhaku raaniyyudi, dhevuni raajyamu eelaativaaridi.
chinna biddavale dhevuni raajyamu angeekarimpanivaadu daanilo enthamaatramunu praveshimpadani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaananenu.
oka adhikaari aayananu chuchi sadbodhakudaa, nitya jeevamunaku vaarasudanagutaku nenemi cheyavalenani aayana nadigenu.
anduku yesu nenu satpurushudanani yela cheppuchunnaavu? dhevudokkade thappa mari evadunu satpurushudu kaadu.
vyabhicharimpa vaddu, narahatyacheya vaddu, dongilavaddu, abaddha saakshyamu palukavaddu, nee thali dandrulanu sanmaanimpumanu aagnalanu eruguduvu gadaa ani athanithoo cheppenu.
andukathadu baalyamunundi veetinannitini anusarinchuchune yunnaananenu.
yesu vinineekinka okati koduvagaa nunnadhi; neeku kaliginavanniyu ammi beedalakimmu, appudu paralokamandu neeku dhanamu kalugunu; neevu vachi nannu vembadimpumani athanithoo cheppenu.
athadu mikkili dhanavanthudu ganuka ee maatalu vini mikkili vyasanapadagaa
yesu athani chuchi aasthigalavaaru dhevuni raajyamulo praveshinchuta enthoo durlabhamu.
dhanavanthudu dhevuni raajyamulo praveshinchuta kante soodibejjamulo ontedooruta sulabhamani cheppenu.
idi vininavaaru aalaagaithe evadu rakshana pondagaladani adugagaa
aayana manushyulaku asaadhyamulainavi dhevuniki saadhyamulani cheppenu.
pethuru idigo memu maaku kaliginavi vidichipetti ninnu vembadinchithimanagaa
aayana dhevuni raajyamu nimitthamai yintinainanu bhaaryanainanu annadammulanainanu thalidandrula nainanu pillalanainanu vidichipettinavaadevadunu,
ihamandu chaalaretlunu paramandu nityajeevamunu pondakapodani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppuchunnaanani vaarithoo anenu.
aayana thana pandrendumandi shishyulanu pilichi idigo yerooshalemunaku velluchunnaamu; manushyakumaaruni goorchi pravakthalachetha vraayabadina maatalanniyu neraverchabadunu.
aayana anyajanula kappagimpabadunu; vaaru aayananu apahasinchi, avamaanaparachi, aayanameeda ummi vesi,
aayananu koradaalathoo kotti champuduru; moodava dinamuna aayana marala lechunani cheppenu.
vaaru ee maatalalo okatainanu grahimpaledu; ee sangathi vaariki marugu cheyabadenu ganuka aayana cheppina sangathulu vaariki bodhapadaledu.
aayana yeriko pattanamunaku sameepinchinappudu oka gruddivaadu trovaprakkanu koorchundi bhikshamadugukonu chundenu.
janasamoohamu daatipovuchunnattu vaadu chappudu vini idi emani adugagaa
vaarunajareyudaina yesu ee maargamuna velluchunnaadani vaanithoo cheppiri.
appudu vaadu yesoo, daaveedu kumaarudaa, nannu karuninchumani kekaluveyagaa
oorakundumani mundhara naduchuchundinavaaru vaanini gaddinchiri gaani, vaadu mari ekkuvagaadaaveedu kumaarudaa, nannu karuninchumani kekaluvesenu.
anthata yesu nilichi, vaanini thanayoddhaku theesikoni rammanenu.
vaadu daggaraku vachinappudu aayana nenu neekemi cheya goruchunnaavani adugagaa, vaaduprabhuvaa, choopu pondagoruchunnaananenu.
yesu choopu pondumu, nee vishvaasamu ninnu svasthaparachenani vaanithoo cheppenu;
ventane vaadu choopupondi dhevuni mahimaparachuchu aayananu vembadinchenu. Prajalandaru adhi chuchi dhevuni sthootramu chesiri.
aayana sancharinchuchu yeriko pattanamulo prave shinchi
daanigundaa povuchundenu. Idigo sunkapu gutthadaarudunu dhanavanthudunaina jakkayya anu perugala okadu
yesu evaroyani choodagorenugaani, potti vaadainanduna janulu gumpukoodi yunduta valana chooda lekapoyenu.
appudu yesu aa trovanu raanai yundenu ganuka athadu mundhugaa parugetthi, aayananu choochutaku oka medi chettekkenu.
yesu aa chootiki vachinappudu, kannuletthi chuchi jakkayyaa tvaragaa digumu, nedu nenu nee yinta nundavalasiyunnadani athanithoo cheppagaa
athadu tvaragaa digi santhooshamuthoo aayananu cherchukonenu.
andaru adhi chuchi eeyana paapiyaina manushyuniyoddha basacheya vellenani chaala sanugukoniri.

jakkayya niluvabadi idigo prabhuvaa, naa aasthilo sagamu beedalakichuchunnaanu; nenevaniyoddha nainanu anyaayamugaa dheninainanu theesikoninayedala athaniki naaluganthalu marala chellinthunani prabhuvuthoo cheppenu.
anduku yesu ithadunu abraahaamu kumaarude; endukanagaa nedu ee yintiki rakshana vachiyunnadhi.
nashinchinadaanini vedaki rakshinchutaku manushyakumaarudu vacchenani athanithoo cheppenu.
vaaru ee maatalu vinuchundagaa thaanu yerooshalemunaku sameepamuna undutavalananu, dhevuni raajyamu ventane agupadunani vaaru thalanchutavalananu, aayana mariyoka upamaanamu cheppenu. emanagaa,
raaja kumaarudoka raajyamu sampaadhinchukoni marala raavale nani dooradheshamunaku prayaanamai
thana daasulanu padhi mandhini pilichi vaariki padhi minaala nichi nenu vachu varaku vyaapaaramu cheyudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
ayithe athani pattanasthulathani dveshinchi'ithadu mammu neluta maa kishtamu ledani athani venuka raayabaaramu pampiri.
athadaa raajyamu sampaadhinchukoni thirigi vachinappudu, prathivaadunu vyaapaaramuvalana ememi sampaadhincheno telisikonutakai thaanu sommichina daasulanu thanayoddhaku piluvumani aagnaapinchenu.
modativaadaayana yedutiki vachi ayyaa, nee minaavalana padhi minaalu labhinchenani cheppagaa
athadu bhalaa, manchi daasudaa, neevu ee konchemulo nammakamugaa untivi ganuka padhi pattanamula meeda adhikaarivai yundumani vaanithoo cheppenu.
anthata rendavavaadu vachi ayyaa, nee minaavalana ayidu minaalu labhinchenanagaa
athadu neevunu ayidu pattanamulameeda undumani athanithoo cheppenu.
anthata mariyokadu vachi ayyaa, yidigo nee minaa;
neevu pettanidaanini etthikonuvaadavunu, vitthanidaanini koyu vaadavunaina kathinudavu ganuka, neeku bhayapadi deenini rumaa luna katti unchithinani cheppenu.
andukathadu chedda daasudaa, nee noti maatanubattiye neeku theerpu theerchudhunu; nenu pettanidaanini yetthu vaadanu, vitthanidaanini koyuvaadanunaina katinudanani neeku telisiyundagaa
neevenduku naa sommu saahukaarulayoddha nunchaledu? Atlu chesi yundinayedala nenu vachi vaddithoo daanini theesikondune ani vaanithoo cheppi
veeniyoddhanundi aa minaa theesivesi padhi minaalu galavaani kiyyudani daggara nilichinavaarithoo cheppenu.
vaaru ayyaa, vaaniki padhi minaalu kalave aniri.
andukathadukaligina prathivaanikini iyya badunu, lenivaaniyoddhanundi vaaniki kaliginadhiyu theesiveyabadunani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
mariyu nenu thammunu elu taku ishtamuleni naa shatruvulanu ikkadiki theesikonivachi naayeduta sanharinchudani cheppenu.
yesu ee maatalu cheppi yerooshalemunaku vella valenani mundu saagipoyenu.
aayana oleevala kondadaggaranunna betpage bethaniya anu graamamula sameepamunaku vachinappudu, thana shishyula niddarini pilichi

meeru edutanunna graamamunaku velludi; andulo meeru praveshimpagaane kattabadiyunna oka gaadida pilla meeku kanabadunu; daanimeeda yee manushyudunu ennadu koorchundaledu; daanini vippi tholukoni randi
evarainanumeerenduku deeni vippu chunnaarani mimmu nadiginayedala idi prabhuvunaku kaavalasiyunnadani athanithoo cheppudani cheppi vaarini pampenu.
pampabadina vaaru velli, aayana thamathoo cheppinatte kanugoni
aa gaadidapillanu vippuchundagaa daani yajamaanulumeeru, gaadida pillanu enduku vippuchunnaarani vaari nadigiri.
anduku vaaru idi prabhuvunaku kaavalasiyunnadaniri.
tharuvaatha vaaru yesunoddhaku daanini thoolukoni vachi, aa gaadidapilla meeda thama battaluvesi, yesunu daanimeeda ekkinchi,
aayana velluchundagaa thama battalu daaripoduguna parachiri.
oleevalakondanundi diguchootiki aayana sameepinchu chunnappudu shishyula samoohamanthayu santhooshinchuchu

prabhuvu perata vachu raaju sthuthimpabadunugaaka paralokamandu samaadhaanamunu sarvonnathamaina sthalamulalo mahimayu undunugaaka ani thaamu chuchina adbhuthamulannitinigoorchi mahaa shabdamuthoo dhevuni sthootramu cheyasaagiri.
aa samoo hamulo unna kondaru parisayyulu bodhakudaa, nee shishyulanu gaddimpumani aayanathoo cheppagaa
aayana vaarini chuchiveeru oorakundinayedala ee raallu kekalu veyunani meethoo cheppuchunnaananenu.
aayana pattanamunaku sameepinchinappudu daanini chuchi daani vishayamai yedchi
neevunu ee nee dinamandainanu samaadhaanasambandhamaina sangathulanu telisikoninayedala neekenthoo melu; gaani yippudavi nee kannulaku marugu cheyabadiyunnavi.
(prabhuvu) ninnu darshinchina kaalamu neevu erugakuntivi ganuka nee shatruvulu nee chuttu gattu katti muttadivesi, anni prakkalanu ninnu arikatti, neelonunna nee pillalathoo kooda ninnu nela kalipi
neelo raathimeeda raayi nilichiyunda niyyani dinamulu vachunani cheppenu.
aayana dhevaalayamulo praveshinchi andulo vikra yamu cheyuvaarithoo naa mandiramu praarthana mandiramu ani vraayabadiyunnadhi.
ayithe meeru daanini dongala guhagaa chesithirani cheppi vaarini vellagotta naarambhinchenu.
aayana prathidinamunu dhevaalayamulo bodhinchu chunnappudu, pradhaanayaajakulunu shaastrulunu prajalalo pradhaanulunu aayananu naashanamucheya joochuchundiri gaani
prajalandaru aayana vaakyamunu vinutaku aayananu hatthukoni yundiri ganuka emi cheyavaleno vaariki thoochaledu.
aa dinamulalo okanaadu aayana dhevaalayamulo prajalaku bodhinchuchu suvaarthanu prakatinchuchunnappudu pradhaanayaajakulunu shaastrulunu peddalathookooda aayana meedikivachi
neevu e adhikaaramuvalana ee kaaryamu cheyuchunnaavo, yee adhikaaramu nee kevadu iccheno maathoo cheppumani aayananu adigiri.
andukaayana nenunu mimmunu oka maata adugudunu, adhi naathoo cheppudi.
yohaanu ichina baapthismamu paralokamu nundi kaliginadaa manushyulanundi kaliginadaa? Ani vaari nadugagaa
vaaru manamu paralokamunundi kaliginadani cheppinayedala--aalaa gaithe mee rendukathani nammaledani aayana manalanu adugunu.
manushyulavalana kaliginadani cheppinayedala prajalandaru manalanu raallathoo kottuduru; yelayanagaa yohaanu pravaktha ani andarunu roodhigaa nammuchunnaarani thamalo thaamu aalochinchukoni
adhi ekkadanundi kaliginado maaku teliyadani aayanaku uttharamichiri.
anduku yesu e adhikaaramuvalana ee kaaryamulu cheyuchunnaano nenu meethoo cheppananivaari thoonanenu.
anthata aayana prajalathoo ee upamaanamu cheppasaagenu oka manushyudu draakshathoota naatinchi, kaapulaku gutthakichi, dheshaantharamupoyi bahukaala mundenu.
pantakaalamandu athadu aa draakshathoota pantalo thana bhaagamimmani aa kaapulayoddha koka daasuni pampagaa aa kaapulu vaanini kotti vattichethulathoo pampivesiri.
marala athadu mariyoka daasuni pampagaa vaaru vaanini kotti avamaanaparachi, vattichethulathoo pampivesiri.
marala nathadu moodavavaani pampagaa vaaru vaanini gaaya parachi velupaliki trosivesiri.
appudaa draakshathoota yajamaanudu nenemi chethunu? Naa priyakumaaruni pampudunu; oka vela vaaru athani sanmaanincheda ranu konenu.
ayinanu aa kaapulu athanini chuchi ithadu vaarasudu; ee svaasthyamu manadagunatlu ithani champudamu randani yokarithoo nokaru aalochinchukoni
athanini draakshathoota velupaliki trosivesi champiri. Kaabatti aa draakshathoota yajamaanudu vaarikemi cheyunu?
athadu vachi aa kaapulanu sanharinchi thana draakshathootanu itharulaku ichunani aayana cheppagaa vaaru vini atlu kaakapovunu gaakaniri.
aayana vaarini chuchi aalaagaithe illu kattuvaaru nishedhinchina raayi moolaku thalaraayi aayenu ani vraayabadina maata emiti?
ee raathimeeda padu prathivaadunu thunakalai povunu; gaani adhi evanimeeda paduno vaanini nalicheyunanenu.
pradhaanayaajakulunu shaastrulunu thammunugoorchi ee upamaanamu aayana cheppenani grahinchi, aa gadiyalone aayananu balaatkaaramugaa pattukona samayamu chuchiri gaani janulaku bhayapadiri.

vaaraayananu kanipettuchu, adhipathi vashamunakunu adhikaaramunakunu aayananu appaginchutakai aayana maatalayandu thappu pattavalenani, thaamu neethimanthulani anipinchukonu vegula vaarini aayanayoddhaku pampiri.
vaaru vachibodhakudaa, neevu nyaayamugaa maatalaaduchunu bodhinchuchu nunnaavu; nee vevani yandunu momotamu leka satyamu gaane dhevuni maargamunu bodhinchuchunnaavani yerugu dumu.
manamu kaisarunaku pannu ichuta nyaayamaa kaadaa ani aayana nadigiri.
aayana vaari kuyukthini gurterigi oka dhenaaramu naaku choopudi.
deenimeedi roopamunu paivraathayu evanivani adugagaa vaaru kaisaru vaniri.
andukaayana aalaagaithe kaisaruvi kaisarunakunu dhevunivi dhevunikini chellinchudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
vaaru prajalayeduta ee maatalo thappu patta neraka aayana pratyuttharamunaku aashcharyapadi oorakundiri.
punarut'thaanamu ledani cheppedi saddookayyulu kondaru aayanayoddhaku vachi aayananu itladigiri.

bodhakudaa, bhaarya bradhikiyundagaa okani sahodarudu santhaanamu leka chanipoyinayedala, athani sahodarudathani bhaaryanu pendlichesikoni thana sahodaruniki santhaanamu kalugajeya valenani moshe manaku vraasi yicchenu.
yeduguru sahodarulundiri. Modativaadoka streeni pendlichesikoni santhaanamu leka chanipoyenu.
rendavavaadunu moodavavaadunu aamenu pendlichesikoniri.
aa prakaarame yedugurunu aamenu pendlaadi santhaanamulekaye chanipoyiri. Pimmata aa streeyu chanipoyenu.
kaabatti punarut'thaanamandu aame vaarilo evaniki bhaaryagaa undunu?
aa yedugurikini aame bhaaryagaa undenu gadaa aniri.
anduku yesu ee lokapu janulu pendlichesikonduru,pendlikiyyabaduduru gaani
paramunu mruthula punarut'thaanamunu pondutaku yogyulani yencha badinavaaru pendlichesikonaru, pendlikiyya badaru.
vaaru punarut'thaanamulo paalivaaraiyundi, dhevadootha samaanulunu dhevuni kumaarulunai yunduru ganuka vaarikanu chaavaneraru.
podanugurinchina bhaagamulo prabhuvu abraahaamu dhevudaniyu issaaku dhevudaniyu yaakobu dhevudaniyu cheppuchu,
mruthulu lethurani moshe soochinchenu; aayana sajeevulake dhevudu kaani mruthulaku dhevudu kaadu; aayana drushtiki andarunu jeevinchu chunnaarani vaariki uttharamicchenu.
tharuvaatha vaaraayananu maremiyu aduga tegimpaledu ganuka shaastrulalo kondaru bodhakudaa,
neevu yukthamugaa cheppithivaniri.
aayana vaarithookreesthu daaveedu kumaarudani janulelaagu cheppuchunnaaru
nenu nee shatruvulanu nee paadamulaku paadapeethamugaa unchuvaraku neevu naakudipaarshvamuna koorchundu mani
prabhuvu naa prabhuvuthoo cheppenu. Ani keerthanala granthamulo daaveedhe cheppiyunnaadu.
daaveedu aayananu prabhuvani cheppinayedala aayana elaagu athani kumaarudagunani cheppenu.
prajalandaru vinuchundagaa aayana itlanenushaastrulanu goorchi jaagratthapadudi. Vaaru niluvutangeelu dharinchukoni thirugagoruchu
santhaveedhulalo vandhanamulanu, samaajamandiramulalo agrapeethamulanu, vindulalo agra sthaanamulanu koruduru.
vaaru vidhavaraandra yindlanu digaminguchu, maayaveshamugaa deerghapraarthanalu cheyuduru. Vaaru mari visheshamugaa shiksha pondudurani thana shishyulathoo cheppenu.
kaanuka pettelo thama kaanukalanu veyuchunna dhanavanthulanu aayana paarajoochenu.
oka beeda vidhavaraalu rendu kaasulu andulo veyuchundagaa chuchi
ee beeda vidhavaraalu andarikante ekkuva vesenani meethoo nijamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
vaarandaru thamaku kaligina samruddhilonundi kaanukalu vesirigaani yeeme thana lemilo thanaku kaligina jeevanamanthayu vesenani vaarithoo cheppenu.
kondaru idi andamaina raallathoonu arpithamulathoonu shrungaarimpabadiyunnadani dhevaalayamunu goorchi, maatalaaduchundagaa
aayana ee kattadamulu meeru choochuchunnaare, vaatilo raathimeeda raayi yunda kunda avi padadroyabadu dinamulu vachu chunnavani cheppenu.
appudu vaaru bodhakudaa, aalaagaithe ivi yeppudu jarugunu? Ivi jarugabovu nani soochana emani aayana nadugagaa
aayana meeru mosapokunda choochukonudi. Anekulu naa perata vachinene aayanananiyu, kaalamu sameepinchenaniyu cheppuduru; meeru vaari vembadipokudi.
meeru yuddhamulanu goorchiyu kalahamulanu goorchiyu vininappudu jadiyakudi; ivi modata jarugavalasiyunnavi gaani anthamu ventane raadani cheppenu.
mariyu aayana vaarithoo itlanenujanamumeediki janamunu raajyamumeediki raajyamunu lechunu;
akkadakkada goppa bhookampamulu kalugunu, tegullunu karavu lunu thatasthinchunu, aakaashamunundi mahaa bhayotpaatha mulunu goppa soochanalunu puttunu.

ivanniyu jarugaka munupu vaaru mimmunu balaatkaaramugaa patti, naa naamamu nimitthamu mimmunu raajulayoddhakunu adhi pathula yoddhakunu theesikonipoyi, samaajamandiramulakunu cherasaalalakunu appaginchi hinsinthuru.
idi saakshyaa rthamai meeku sambhavinchunu.
kaabatti mememi samaadhaanamu cheppudumaa ani mundhugaa chinthimpakundumani mee manassulo nishchayinchukonudi.
mee virodhulandaru eduraadutakunu, kaadanutakunu veelukaani vaakkunu gnaanamunu nenu meeku anugrahinthunu.
thalidandrulachethanu sahodarulachethanu bandhuvulachethanu snehithulachethanu meeru appagimpabaduduru; vaaru meelo kondarini champinthuru;
naa naamamu nimitthamu meeru manushyulandarichetha dveshimpabaduduru.
gaani mee thala vendrukalalo okatainanu nashimpadu.
meeru mee orpuchetha mee praanamulanu dakkinchukonduru.
yerooshalemu dandlachetha chuttabaduta meeru choochunappudu daani naashanamu sameepamaiyunnadani telisi konudi.
appudu yoodayalo unduvaaru kondalaku paaripovalenu; daani madhyanunduvaaru velupaliki povalenu; palletoollalonivaaru daanilo praveshimpa koodadu.
lekhanamulalo vraayabadina vanniyu nera verutakai avi prathi dandana dinamulu.
aa dinamulalo garbhinulakunu paalichuvaarikini shrama. bhoomimeeda mikkili yibbandiyu ee prajalameeda kopamunu vachunu.
vaaru katthivaatha kooluduru; cherapattabadina vaarai samasthamaina anyajanamula madhyaku povuduru; anyajanamula kaalamulu sampoornamaguvaraku yeroosha lemu anyajanamulachetha trokkabadunu.
mariyu soorya chandra nakshatramulalo soochanalunu, bhoomimeeda samudratharangamula ghoshavalana kalavarapadina janamulaku shramayu kalugunu.
aakaashamandali shakthulu kadhilimpa badunu ganuka lokamu meediki raabovuchunna vaati vishayamai bhayamu kaligi, manushyulu eduruchoochuchu dhairyamuchedi kooluduru.
appudu manushyakumaarudu prabhaavamuthoonu mahaa mahimathoonu meghaaroodhudai vachuta choothuru.
ivi jaruga naarambhinchinappudu meeru dhairyamu techukoni mee thalaletthikonudi, mee vidudala sameepinchuchunnadanenu.
mariyu aayana vaarithoo ee upamaanamu cheppenu anjoorapu vrukshamunu samastha vruksha mulanu choodudi.
avi chigirinchutachuchi vasantha kaalamappude sameepamaaye nani mee anthata meeru telisi konduru gadaa?
atuvale meeru ee sangathulu jaruguta chuchinappudu dhevuni raajyamu sameepamaayenani telisikonudi.
avanniyu jaruguvaraku ee tharamu gathimpadani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
aakaashamunu bhoomiyu gathinchunu gaani naa maatalemaatramunu gathimpavu.

mee hrudayamulu okavela thindivalananu matthuvalananu aihika vichaaramulavalananu mandamugaa unnanduna aa dinamu akasmaatthugaa mee meediki urivachinattu raakunda mee vishayamai meeru jaagratthagaa undudi.
aa dinamu bhoomiyandanthata nivasinchu vaarandarimeediki akasmaatthugaa vachunu.
kaabatti meeru jarugabovu veetinellanu thappinchu koni, manushyakumaaruni yeduta niluvabadutaku shakthigala vaaragunatlu ellappudunu praarthanacheyuchu melakuvagaa undudani cheppenu.
aayana prathidinamu pagatiyandu dhevaalayamulo bodhinchuchu raatrivela oleevalakondaku velluchu kaalamu gadupuchundenu.
prajalandaru aayana maata vinutaku dhevaalayamulo aayanayoddhaku pendalakada vachuchundiri.
paskaa anabadina puliyani rottela panduga samee pinchenu.
pradhaanayaajakulunu shaastrulunu prajalaku bhayapadiri ganuka aayananu elaagu champinthumani upaayamu vedakuchundiri.
anthata pandrendumandi shishyula sankhyalo cherina iskariyothu anabadina yoodhaalo saathaanu praveshinchenu
ganuka vaadu velli, aayananu vaarikelaagu appagimpavachuno daaninigoorchi pradhaana yaajakulathoonu adhipathulathoonu maatalaadenu.
anduku vaaru santhoo shinchi vaaniki dravyamiyya sammathinchiri.
vaadu anduku oppukoni, janasamoohamu lenappudu aayananu vaariki appaginchutaku thagina samayamu vedakuchundenu.
paskaapashuvunu vadhimpavalasina puliyani rottela dinamuraagaa
yesu pethurunu yohaanunu chuchimeeru velli manamu bhujinchutakai paskaanu manakoraku siddhaparachudani vaarini pampenu.
vaarumemekkada siddhaparachagoruchunnaavani aayananu adugagaa
aayana idigo meeru pattanamulo praveshinchunappudu neellakunda mosikonipovuchunna yokadu meeku edurugaa vachunu; athadu praveshinchu intiloniki athani venta velli
nenu naa shishyulathoo kooda paskaanu bhujinchutaku vididi gadhi yekkadanani bodhakudu ninnaduguchunnaadani yinti yajamaanunithoo cheppudi.
athadu saamagrigala yoka goppa medagadhi meeku choopinchunu; akkada siddha parachudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
vaaru velli aayana thamathoo cheppinattu kanugoni paskaanu siddhaparachiri.
aa gadiya vachinappudu aayanayu aayanathookooda aposthalulunu pankthini koorchundiri.
appudaayana nenu shramapadakamunupu meethookooda ee paskaanu bhujimpavalenani mikkili aashapadithini.
adhi dhevuni raajya mulo neraveruvaraku ika ennadunu daani bhujimpanani meethoo cheppuchunnaanani vaarithoo cheppi
aayana ginne etthikoni kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchimeeru deenini theesi koni meelo panchukonudi;
ikameedata dhevuni raajyamu vachuvaraku nenu draakshaarasamu traaganani meethoo cheppu chunnaananenu.

pimmata aayana yoka rotte pattukoni kruthagnathaasthu thulu chellinchi daani virichi, vaari kichi'idi mee koraku iyyabaduchunna naa shareeramu; nannu gnaapakamu chesikonutaku deenini cheyudani cheppenu.
aa prakaarame bhojanamaina tharuvaatha aayana ginneyu pattu koni'ee ginne meekoraku chindimpabaduchunna naa rakthamu valana naina krottha nibandhana.
idigo nannu appaginchu vaani cheyyi naathookooda ee ballameeda unnadhi.
nirnayimpabadina prakaaramu manushyakumaarudu povu chunnaadugaani aayana evarichetha appagimpabaduchunnaado aa manushyuniki shramayani cheppenu.
vaaru'ee panini cheyabovuvaadevaro ani thamalo thaamu adugukona saagiri.
thamalo evadu goppavaadugaa enchabaduno anu vivaadamu vaarilo puttagaa
aayana vaarithoo itlanenu anyajanamulalo raajulu vaarimeeda prabhutvamu cheyuduru; vaarimeeda adhikaaramu cheyuvaaru upa kaarulanabaduduru.
meeraithe aalaagu undaraadu; meelo goppavaadu chinnavaanivalenu, adhipathi parichaarakuni valenu undavalenu.
goppavaadevadu? Bhojanapankthini koorchunduvaadaa paricharyacheyuvaadaa? Pankthinikoorchundu vaade gadaa? Ayinanu nenu mee madhya paricharya cheyu vaanivale unnaanu.
naa shodhanalalo naathoo kooda nilichi yunnavaaru meere;
ganuka naathandri naaku raajyamunu niyaminchinattugaa naa raajyamulo naa ballayoddha annapaanamulu puchukoni,
sinhaasanamula meeda koorchundi ishraayelu pandrendu gotramulavaariki meeru theerputheerchutakai, nenunu meeku raajyamunu niyaminchuchunnaanu.
seemonoo, seemonoo, idigo saathaanu mimmunu patti godhumalavale jallinchutaku mimmunu korukonenu gaani
nee nammika thappipokundunatlu nenu neekoraku vedukontini; nee manasu thirigina tharuvaatha nee sahodarulanu sthiraparachumani cheppenu.
ayithe athadu prabhuvaa, neethookooda cheralonikini maranamunakunu vellutaku siddhamugaa unnaanani aayanathoo anagaa
aayanapethuroo, neevu nanneruganani mummaaru cheppu varaku, nedu kodikooyadani neethoo cheppuchunnaananenu.
mariyu aayanasanchiyu jaaleyu cheppulunu lekunda nenu mimmunu pampinappudu, meeku emainanu thakkuvaayenaa ani vaarinadiginappudu vaaru'emiyu thakkuvakaaledaniri.
andukaayana ippudaithe sanchi galavaadu sanchiyu jaaleyu theesikoni povalenu; katthi lenivaadu thana battanammi katthi konukkonavalenu;
aayana akramakaarulalo okadugaa enchabadenu ani vraayabadina maata naayandu neraveravalasiyunnadhi; yelayanagaa nannugoorchina sangathi samaapthamavuchunnadani meethoo cheppuchunnaananenu.
vaaru prabhuvaa, idigo ikkada rendu katthulunnavanagaa-chaalunani aayana vaarithoo cheppenu.
tharuvaatha aayana bayaludheri, thana vaaduka choppuna oleevalakondaku vellagaa shishyulunu aayanaventa velliri.
aa chootu cheri aayana vaarithoomeeru shodhanalo praveshinchakundunatlu praarthanacheyudani cheppi
vaari yoddha nundi raathivetha dooramu velli mokaallooni
thandree, yee ginne naa yoddhanundi (tolaginchutaku) nee chithamaithe tolaginchumu; ayinanu naa yishtamukaadu, nee chitthame siddhinchunugaaka ani praarthinchenu.
appudu para lokamunundi yokadootha aayanaku kanabadi aayananu balaparachenu.
aayana vedhanapadi marintha aathuramugaa praarthana cheyagaa aayana chemata, nela paduchunna goppa raktha binduvulavale aayenu.
aayana praarthana chaalinchi lechi thana shishyulayoddhaku vachi, vaaru duḥkhamu chetha nidrinchuta chuchi
meerenduku nidrinchu chunnaaru? shodhanalo praveshinchakundunatlu lechi praarthana cheyudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
aayana inkanu maatalaaduchundagaa, idigo janulu gumpugaa vachiri. Pandrendumandilo yoodhaa ana badinavaadu vaarikante mundhugaa nadichi, yesunu muddu pettukonutaku aayanayoddhaku raagaa
yesu yoodhaa, neevu muddupettukoni manushyakumaaruni appaginchu chunnaavaa ani vaanithoo anagaa
aayana chuttuunna vaaru jarugabovu daanini chuchiprabhuvaa, katthithoo narukudumaa ani aayananu adigiri.
anthalo vaarilo okadu pradhaanayaajakuni daasuni kotti, vaani kudi chevi teganarikenu.
ayithe yesu ee mattuku thaaludani cheppi, vaani chevi mutti baaguchesenu.
yesu thannu pattukonavachina pradhaanayaajakulathoonu dhevaalayapu adhipathulathoonu peddalathoonumeeru bandipotu donga meediki vachinattu katthulathoonu gudiyalathoonu bayaludheri vachithiraa?
nenu anudinamu meechentha dhevaalayamulo unnappudu meeru nannu pattukonaledu; ayithe idi mee gadiyayu andhakaara sambandhamaina adhikaaramunu anenu.
vaaraayananu patti yeedchukonipoyi pradhaana yaajakuni yintiloniki theesikonipoyiri. Pethuru doora mugaa vaari venuka vachuchundenu.
anthata kondaru nadumungita mantavesi chuttu koorchundi nappudu, pethurunu vaari madhyanu koorchundenu.
appudoka chinnadhi aa manta veluthurulo athadu koorchunduta chuchi athani therichuchiveedunu athanithoo kooda undenani cheppenu.
anduku pethuru ammaayee, nenathani nerugananenu.
mari kontha sepatiki mariyokadu athani chuchineevunu vaarilo okadavanagaa pethuru oyee, nenu kaananenu.
inchuminchu oka gadiyayaina tharuvaatha mariyokadu nijamugaa veedunu athanithoo kooda undenu, veedu galilayudani drudhamugaa cheppenu.
anduku pethuru oyee, neevu cheppinadhi naaku teliya danenu. Athadinkanu maatalaaduchundagaa ventane kodi koosenu.
appudu prabhuvu thirigi pethuru vaipu chuchenu ganuka pethuru nedu kodi kooyakamunupu neevu mummaaru nannu erugananduvani prabhuvu thanathoo cheppina maata gnaapakamu chesikoni
velupalikipoyi santhaapapadi yedchenu.
yesunu pattukonina manushyulu aayananu apahasinchi kotti, aayana mukhamu kappi,
ninnu kottina vaadevado pravachimpumani aayananu adigi
aayanaku virodhamugaa inkanu aneka dooshana vachanamulaadiri.
udayamu kaagaane prajala peddalunu pradhaana yaajakulunu shaastrulunu sabhakoodi, aayananu thama mahaa sabhaloniki theesikonipoyi
neevu kreesthuvaithe maathoo cheppumaniri. Andukaayana nenu meethoo cheppinayedala meeru nammaru.
adhiyugaaka nenu mimmunu adiginayedala meeru naaku uttharamu chepparu.
idi modalukoni manushyakumaarudu mahaatmyamugala dhevuni kudipaarshvamuna aaseenudagunani vaarithoo cheppenu.
anduku vaarandaru atlayithe neevu dhevuni kumaarudavaa? Ani adugagaa aayana meerannattu nene aayananu ani vaarithoo cheppenu.
anduku vaaru manakika saakshulathoo pani emi? Manamu athani notimaata vintimigadaa ani cheppiri.
anthata vaarandarunu lechi aayananu pilaathunoddhaku theesikonipoyi
ithadu maa janamunu thirugabada prerepinchuchu, kaisarunaku panniyyavaddaniyu, thaane kreesthanu oka raajunaniyu cheppagaa memu vintimani aayanameeda neramu mopasaagiri.
pilaathu neevu yoodula raajuvaa ani aayananu adugagaa aayananee vannatte ani athanithoo cheppenu.
pilaathu pradhaana yaajakulathoonu janasamoohamulathoonu ee manushyuni yandu naaku e neramunu kanabadaledanenu.
ayithe vaaru ithadu galilaya dheshamu modalukoni inthavarakunu yoodaya dheshamandanthata upadheshinchuchu prajalanu repu chunnaadani marintha pattudalagaa cheppiri.
pilaathu ee maata vini ee manushyudu galilayudaa ani adigi
aayana herodu adhikaaramu krinda unna pradheshapu vaadani telisikoni herodunoddhaku aayananu pampenu. Herodu aa dinamulalo yerooshalemulo undenu.
herodu yesunu chuchi mikkili santhooshinchenu. aayananugoorchi chaala sangathulu vinnanduna aayana edainanu oka soochaka kriya cheyagaa chooda nireekshinchi, bahukaalamunundi aayananu choodago renu.
aayananu chuchinappudu chaala prashnaluvesinanu aayana athaniki uttharamemiyu iyyaledu.
pradhaanayaajakulunu shaastrulunu niluvabadi aayanameeda theekshanamugaa neramu mopiri.
herodu thana sainikulathoo kalisi, aayananu truneekarinchi apahasinchi, aayanaku prashasthamaina vastramu todiginchi pilaathunoddhaku marala pampenu.
anthaku mundu herodunu pilaathunu okanikokadu shatruvulai yundi aa dinamunane yokanikokadu mitrulairi.
anthata pilaathu pradhaanayaajakulanu adhikaarulanu prajalanu pilipinchi
prajalu thirugabadunatlu cheyu chunnaadani meereemanushyuni naayoddhaku techi thire. Idigo nenu meeyeduta ithanini vimarshimpagaa mee rithani meeda mopina neramulalo okkatainanu naaku kanabada ledu;
herodunaku kooda kanabadaledu.Herodu athani maayoddhaku thirigi pampenu gadaa; idigo marana munaku thaginadhediyu ithadu cheyaledu.
kaabatti nenithanini
shikshinchi vidudala cheyudunani vaarithoo cheppagaa
vaarandaru veenini champivesi maaku barabbanu vidudala cheyumani ekagreevamugaa kekaluvesiri.
veedu pattanamulo jariginchina yoka allari nimitthamunu narahatya nimitthamunu cherasaalalo veyabadinavaadu.
pilaathu yesunu vidudala cheyagori vaarithoo thirigi maatalaadinanu.
vaaru veenini siluvaveyumu siluvaveyumu ani kekalu vesiri.
moodava maaru athadu'enduku? Ithadu e dushkaaryamu chesenu? Ithaniyandu maranamunaku thagina neramemiyu naaku agapadaledu ganuka ithani shikshinchi vidudala chethunani vaarithoo cheppenu.
ayithe vaaroke pattugaa pedda kekaluvesi, veenini siluvaveyumani adugagaa vaari kekale gelichenu.
kaagaa vaaradiginatte jarugavalenani pilaathu theerputheerchi
allari nimitthamunu narahatya nimittha munu cherasaalalo veyabadiyundinavaanini vaaradiginattu vaariki vidudalachesi, yesunu vaarikishtamu vachinattu cheyutaku appaginchenu.
vaaraayananu theesikonipovuchundagaa palletoorinundi vachuchunna kureneeyudaina seemonanu okani pattukoni, yesuventa siluvanu moyutaku athanimeeda daanini pettiri.
goppa janasamoohamunu, aayananugoorchi rommukottu konuchu duḥkhinchuchunna chaalamandi streelunu aayananu vembadinchiri.
yesu vaarivaipu thirigiyerooshalemu kumaarthelaaraa, naa nimitthamu edvakudi; mee nimitthamunu mee pillala nimitthamunu edvudi.
idigo godraandrunu kanani garbhamulunu paaliyyani sthanamulunu dhanyamulainavani cheppudinamulu vachuchunnavi.
appudu maameeda padudani parvathamulathoonu, mammu kappudani kondalathoonu janulu cheppasaaguduru.
vaaru pachi mraanuke yeelaagu chesinayedala endinadaanikemi cheyuduro ani cheppenu.
mari yiddaru aayanathookooda champabadutaku thebadiri; vaaru neramu chesinavaaru.
vaaru kapaalamanabadina sthalamunaku vachinappudu akkada kudivaipuna okanini edamavaipuna okanini aa nerasthulanu aayanathoo kooda siluvavesiri.
yesu thandree, veeremi cheyuchunnaaro veererugaru ganuka veerini kshaminchumani cheppenu. Vaaru aayana vastramulu panchukonutakai chitluvesiri.
prajalu niluvabadi choochu chundiri; adhikaarulunuveedu itharulanu rakshinchenu; veedu dhevuderparachukonina kreesthu ayina yedala thannuthaanu rakshinchukonunani apahasinchiri.
anthata sainikulu aayanayoddhaku vachi aayanaku chirakanichi
neevu yoodula raajuvaithe ninnu neeve rakshinchukonumani aayananu apahasinchiri.
ithadu yoodula raajani paivilaasamukooda aayanaku paigaa vraayabadenu.
vrelaadaveyabadina aa nerasthulalo okadu aayananu dooshinchuchu neevu kreesthuvu gadaa? Ninnu neevu rakshinchu konumu, mammunukooda rakshinchumani cheppenu.
ayithe rendavavaadu vaanini gaddinchineevu adhe shikshaavidhilo unnaavu ganuka dhevuniki bhayapadavaa?
manakaithe yidi nyaayame; manamu chesinavaatiki thagina phalamu pondu chunnaamu gaani yeeyana e thappidamunu cheyaledani cheppi
aayananu chuchi yesoo, neevu nee raajyamu loniki vachunappudu nannu gnaapakamu chesikonumanenu.
andu kaayana vaanithoonedu neevu naathookooda para daisulo unduvani nishchayamugaa neethoo cheppuchunnaa nanenu.
appudu ramaarami madhyaahnamaayenu. adhi modalukoni moodu gantalavaraku aa dheshamanthatimeeda chikati kammenu;
sooryudu adrushyudaayenu; garbhaa layapu tera nadimiki chinigenu.
appudu yesu goppa shabdamuthoo kekavesi -thandree, nee chethiki naa aatmanu appaginchukonuchunnaananenu. aayana yeelaagu cheppi praanamu vidichenu.
shathaadhipathi jariginadhi chuchi ee manushyudu nijamugaa neethimanthudai yundenani cheppi dhevuni mahimaparachenu.
choochutakai koodivachina prajalandaru jarigina kaaryamulu chuchi, rommu kottu konuchu thirigi velliri.
aayanaku nelavainavaarandarunu, galilayanundi aayananu vemba dinchina streelunu dooramugaa niluchundi veetini choochuchundiri.
arimathayiya anu yoodula pattanapu sabhyudaina yosepu anu okadundenu.
athadu sajjanudunu neethimanthudunai yundi vaari aalochanakunu vaaru chesina panikini sammathimpaka dhevuni raajyamukoraku kanipettu chundinavaadu.
athadu pilaathunoddhaku velli, yesu dhehamu (thanakimmani) adugukoni
daanini krindiki dinchi, sannapu naarabattathoo chutti, tolichina raathi samaadhilo unchenu. Andulo evadunu anthaku munupeppudunu unchabadaledu.
aa dinamu siddhaparachu dinamu; vishraanthi dinaarambhamu kaavacchenu.
appudu galilayanundi aayanathoo kooda vachina streelu venta velli aa samaadhini, aayana dhehamu elaagunchabadeno chuchi
thirigi velli, sugandha dravyamulanu parimala thailamulanu siddhaparachi, aagnachoppuna vishraanthidinamuna theerikagaa undiri.
aadhivaaramuna tellavaaruchundagaa (aa streelu) thaamu siddhaparachina sugandha dravyamulanu theesikoni samaadhi yoddhaku vachi
samaadhimundhara undina raayi doralimpa badiyunduta chuchi lopaliki velliri gaani
prabhuvaina yesu dhehamu vaariki kanabadaledu.
indunugoorchi vaarikemiyu thoochakayundagaa, prakaashamaanamaina vastramulu dharinchina yiddaru manushyulu vaariyoddha niluvabadiri.
vaaru bhayapadi mukhamulanu nela mopi yundagaa veerusajeevudaina vaanini mee renduku mruthulalo vedakuchunnaaru?
aayana ikkadaledu, aayana lechiyunnaadu; aayana inka galilayalo undi nappudu
manushyakumaarudu paapishthulaina manushyula chethiki appagimpabadi, siluvaveyabadi, moodava dinamandu levavalasiyunnadani aayana meethoo cheppina maata gnaapakamu chesikonudani vaarithoo
appudu vaaraayana maatalu gnaapakamu chesikoni
samaadhi yoddhanundi thirigi velli yee sangathulanniyu padunokanduguru shishyulakunu thakkinavaarikandarikini teliyajesiri.
ee sangathulu aposthalulathoo cheppina vaarevaranagaa magdalene mariyayu yohannayu yaakobu thalliyaina mariyayu vaarithoo kooda unna yithara streelunu.
ayithe vaari maatalu veeri drushtiki verrimaatalugaa kanabadenu ganuka veeru vaari maatalu nammaledu.
ayithe pethuru lechi, samaadhi yoddhaku parugetthikonipoyi vangichoodagaa, naarabattalu maatramu vidigaa kanabadenu. Athadu jariginadaanini goorchi aashcharyapaduchu intiki vellenu.
idigo aa dinamandhe vaarilo iddaru yerooshalemunaku aamadadooramuna unna emmaayu anu oka graama munaku velluchu
jarigina ee sangathulanni tinigoorchi yokarithoo nokaru sambhaashinchuchundiri.
vaaru sambhaashinchuchu aalochinchukonuchundagaa, yesu thaane daggarakuvachi vaarithookooda nadichenu;
ayithe vaaraayananu gurthu pattalekunda vaari kannulu mooyabadenu.
aayana meeru naduchuchu okarithoo okaru cheppukonuchunna yee maata lemani adugagaa vaaru duḥkhamukhulai nilichiri.
vaarilo kleyopaa anuvaadu yerooshalemulo basa cheyuchundi, yee dinamulalo akkada jarigina sangathulu neevokadave yerugavaa? Ani aayananu adigenu.
aayana avi evani vaarini adiginappudu vaarunajareyudaina yesunu goorchina sangathule; aayana dhevuniyedutanu prajalandariyedutanu kriyalonu vaakyamulonu shakthi gala pravakthayai yundenu.
mana pradhaana yaajakulunu adhikaarulunu aayananu elaagu maranashikshaku appaginchi, siluvaveyinchiro neeku teliyadaa?
ishraayelunu vimochimpabovuvaadu eeyane ani memu nireekshinchi yuntimi; idigaaka yee sangathulu jarigi netiki moodu dinamulaayenu.
ayithe maalo kondaru streelu tella vaaragaane samaadhiyoddhaku velli, aayana dhehamunu kaanaka vachi
kondaru dhevadoothalu thamaku kanabadi aayana bradhikiyunnaadani cheppirani maathoo cheppi maaku vismayamu kalugajesiri.
maathookooda unnavaarilo kondaru samaadhiyoddhaku velli aa streelu cheppinattu kanugoniri gaani, aayananu choodaledani aayanathoo cheppiri.
andu kaayana avivekulaaraa, pravakthalu cheppina maatalanannitini nammani mandamathulaaraa,
kreesthu eelaagu shramapadi thana mahimalo praveshinchuta agatyamu kaadaa ani vaarithoo cheppi
mosheyu samastha pravakthalunu modalu koni lekhanamulannitilo thannu goorchina vachanamula bhaavamu vaariki telipenu.
inthalo thaamu velluchunna graamamu daggaraku vachinappudu aayana yinka konthadooramu vellunatlu agapadagaa
vaaru saayankaalamu kaavachinadhi, proddu grunkinadhi, maathookooda undumani cheppi, aayananu balavanthamuchesiri ganuka aayana vaarithoo kooda undutaku lopaliki vellenu.
aayana vaarithoo kooda bhojanamunaku koorchunnappudu, oka rottenu pattukoni sthootramu chesi daani virichi vaariki panchi pettagaa
vaari kannulu teravabadi aayananu gurthupattiri; anthata aayana vaariki adrushyudaayenu.
appudu vaaru aayana trovalo manathoo maatalaaduchu lekhanamulanu manaku bodhaparachu chunnappudu mana hrudayamu manalo manduchundaledaa ani yokanithoo okadu cheppukoniri.
aa gadiyalone vaaru lechi, yerooshalemunaku thirigi vellagaa, padu nokonduguru shishyulunu vaarithoo kooda unnavaarunu koodivachi
prabhuvu nijamugaa lechi seemonunaku kana badenani cheppukonuchundiri. Vaaridi vini
trovalo jarigina sangathulunu, aayana rotte viruchutavalana thama kelaagu teliyabadeno adhiyu teliyajesiri.
vaaru eelaagu maatalaaduchundagaa aayana vaari madhyanu nilichi--meeku samaadhaanamavugaakani vaarithoo anenu.
ayithe vaaru digulupadi bhayaakraanthulai, bhoothamu thamaku kanabadenani thalanchiri.
appudaayanameerenduku kalavarapaduchunnaaru? mee hruda yamulalo sandhehamulu puttanela?
nene aayananu anutaku naa chethulanu naa paadamulanu choodudi; nannu patti choodudi, naa kunnattugaa meeru choochuchunna yemukalunu maansa munu bhoothamuna kundavani cheppi
thana chethulanu paadamu lanu vaariki choopenu.
ayithe vaaru santhooshamuchetha inkanu nammaka aashcharyapaduchundagaa aayana'ikkada meeyoddha emaina aahaaramu kaladaa ani vaarinadigenu.
vaaru kaalchina chepa mukkanu aayana kichiri.
aayana daanini theesikoni vaariyeduta bhujinchenu.

anthata aayana–moshe dharmashaastramulonu pravakthala granthamulalonu, keerthanalalonu nannugoorchi vraayabadina vanniyu neraveravalenani nenu meeyoddha undinappudu meethoo cheppina maatalu neraverinavani vaarithoo cheppenu
appudu vaaru lekhanamulu grahinchunatlugaa aayana vaari manassunu terachi
kreesthu shramapadi moodava dina muna mruthulalonundi lechunaniyu
yerooshalemu modalukoni samastha janamulalo aayanaperata maarumanassunu paapakshamaapanayu prakatimpabadunaniyu vraayabadiyunnadhi.
ee sangathulaku meere saakshulu
idigo naa thandri vaagdaanamu chesinadhi meemeediki pampu chunnaanu; meeru painundi shakthi ponduvaraku pattanamulo nilichi yundudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
aayana bethaniyavaraku vaarini theesikonipoyi chethu letthi vaarini aasheervadhinchenu.
vaarini aasheervadhinchuchundagaa aayana vaarilonundi pratyekimpabadi paralokamunaku aarohanudaayenu.
vaaru aayanaku namaskaaramu chesi mahaa aanandamuthoo yerooshalemunaku thirigi velli
yedategaka dhevaalayamulo undi dhevuni sthootramu cheyuchundiri.
